nyin gcig 6)bzhin du dus gsum du (snyedage sbyong gi ta ma la bdug ①pa dang /phye ma dang spos dang me tog rnams kyis bkur stir byed kyi (4)pad ma 'di bdag (5)gis de la 'bul yibar bya'o snyam nas/ de (7)khyer te mnyan du yod par song ngo / /de'i tshe srid ⑧med kyi bu la dad pa zhig lho)ya mtshan can thams cad la mchod sbyin byed pa la zhugs so/ /de nas des 7mi des 37dus ma yin pa'i pad ma de lta bu khyer te/ 'ong ba yang 8mthong nas/ des de la smras pa/ kye mi khyod kyi 8pad ma 'o ni bdag la byin cig dang / 'di 8bdag gis legs ldan sred med kyi bu la mchod par bya'o/ /khyod la yang bdag gis kār ṣā pa ṇa lnga brgya sbyin no zhes byas so/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin 7g.yog 'khor lnga brgya dang /bcom ldan 'das la yibalta ba'i phyir chas pa las/ khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis mi de ⑩tshig de skad zer ba thos so/ /thos nas kyang des bsams pa/'di ni nyes 8par bshad pa'i chos can yin na/ nor gyi /6bungs 'di snyed cig nyos 6)te sred med kyi bu la 'bul ( nyabar 'dod na/ ci'i phyir ngas nor ches ⑥mang du bskyed de nyos la/ bcom ldan 'das la dbul 4)bar mi bya snyam nas/des kun dga' ra ba'i sungs ( stem la smras pa/ ngas khyod la kār ṣā pa ṇa stong sbyin gyi(ste/ pad ma 'o ni nga la byin cig /de nas sred med kyi bu la dad pa des thos nas nga rgyal skyes te/ des kār ṣā pa ṇa nyis stong sbyin ( nyapar byas so/ /de bzhin du de gnyis kyis 0kār ṣā pa ṇa 'bum gyi bar du gong nas gong du bskyed do/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungs ma de'i ()blo skyes pa/ 'di ltar khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin lta bus mi zhig ( rtegi phyir 'bum gtong 63 bar byed pa dang sbyar na/ dge slong dustogi ta ma de ni so che ba zhig yin (snyegor ma chag na/(ste74—101

ci'i phyir bdag nyid song la/ bcom ldan 'das de la mchod par mi bya snyam du ①bsams nas/ kun dga' ra ba'i srungs snom des khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin la smras pa/ khyim bdag bdag la nor mi dgos kyi / bdag nyid kyis bcom ldan 'das de la mchod par bya'o zhes byas nas/ pad ma de khyer te rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song nas/ kun dga' dur ba'i srungs dum des/ thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu durtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan cing spa ⑦bar byas pa/ me lus kyi dbyibs su 'dug pa lta bu/ me lce mar gyis btab pa lta bu/ mar me gser gyi snod du bzhag pa lta bu/ mchod sdong rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa lta bu/ blo gsal zhing dri ma med la(gyi/ rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa'i phyir steng du bor na6)/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus pad ma de shing rta'i 'phang 0lo tsam du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ni 'gro'o/ /gzhes yin ni sdod do/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungs tsom des/ cho 'phrul de lta bu tsomathong nas/lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab pa/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis ④bdag 'jig rten long ba tso'adren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes 74—102

bu 'dul ba'i ①kha lo sgyur ②ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' ra ba'i srungs dum de la bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs ④legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyod du'ajig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ⑤kha lo sgyur ⑦ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das pad ma'i bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// //pad ma gnyis pa ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa de nyid na/ kun dga' ra ba srung ba nizhig 'dug pa/ de'i ⑨mtsho'i nang nas ⑩dus ma yin par ⑩pad ma zhig skyes te/ de'i blo skyes pa/pad ma 'di bdag 8gis rgyal po gsal rgyal la dbul 8bar bya'o/ /'on tang ⑫bdag gi longs spyod chen po dag gi 'byung khungs su 8'gyur ro snyam nas/ de khyer 0te rgyal po'i pho brang du chas te song ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig 0pu'i lam ston pa/ rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya dang / ye shes la mnga' brnyes pa/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag 8pa gsum la mkhas payi / mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs padu / 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs 74—103

dang ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i ①seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs (9pa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgyadag/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs (4)shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur(9/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs (7pa dang nyam sting ba dang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol / su ni ngan song du 'bab(nya/ su ni ngan song du bab/5nye su ni ngas ⑩ngan song nas phyung ste mtho ris dang thar pa dang (nya'abras bu la gzhag yonyepar bya/su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar ()bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las yi'aphags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin zin pa las ye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol bar bya/ su la ⑩ni sangs rgyas byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu yod par bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /7dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /'dul yonabar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba yo med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ kun dga' ra ba'i srungs ma de /dze+e/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par sems bskyed par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te lhung bzed bsnams nas/ mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs so/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungs ( )ma des/ thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas 74—104

bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas bsams pa/ bdag gis rgyal po gsal rgyal btang la/ bcom ldan 'das la 6)bdag nyid kyis mchod pa ②bya'o snyam nas/ des pad ma de bcom ldan 'das kyi steng gi nam mkha' la ③bor ba lasal/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus pad ma de shing rta'i 'phang golo tsam du gyur te / bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ni 'gro'o/ /gzhes (gyen ni sdod doyi/ /de nas kun dga' ra ba'i srungs ⑦ma des cho 'phrul de lta bu mthong nas/ lhag par yang (nyabacom ldan 'das ⑨la shin tu dga' bar gyur te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na ⑩bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ⑩kha lo sgyur ⑩ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun dga' ra ba'i sungs (nyam de la bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs ⑫legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyod 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med paratso/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i 7kha lo sgyur 1 snab/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// //74—105

lta ba zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi ①mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang mnyam pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang ②'gran pa zhig gnas te/ khyim bdag de yang byams pa'i rang bzhin can/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad ②la mnyes gshin ④pa/ sbyin pa la sred pa/ ya mtshan can thams cad dang lta ba mtshungs pa / sbyin pa la blo snyoms pa zhig ste/ des 0dus dus su mchod sbyin chen po byed la/ bstan bcos spyod pa rnams ①kyi gzhung spyod ⑦par byed do/ /des bltas dun thams cad kyang bdag la ni stod⑨/ gzhan la ni smod ⑩par byed pas / de dag gis khyim bdag de'i sems ma mgu'o⑩/ /de nas phyi zhig na khyim bdag des/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bsngags 8pa thos nas de 'di snyam du sems te / des chos thams cad rtogs pa las na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni thams cad mkhyen pa yin par nges so snyam nas/ bsngags pa 8thos ma thag tu sems skyes 8pa/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das de bdag gi byamachod sbyin gyi gnas 'dir gshegs kyang ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/bdag gis khyim bdag de'i (9dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed par bya dgos la/'di la 4)brten nas 'dul tunyebar bya ba phal po che drang du yod do snyam nas/rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te/ khyim bdag de'i mchod sbyin gyi gnas su zhugs yipar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag des thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang chadaga' ba skyes sol/ /dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom 74—106

ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ / kye ma ①bcom ldan 'das ②bdag gi mchod sbyin gyi gnas su gshegs te/ longs spyod par mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de la cang mi gsung bas ①gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun bde bar bzhugs par rig nas/rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po mang pos tshim par byas te/ ci bzhed 0pa bstabs nas chos nyan ⑤pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 0bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ④byang chub tu spro ba bskyed nas/ khyim bdag de bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dod pa skyes ⑧nas/ des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa zla ba gsum spyan drangs te/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du yo byad thams cad sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa yo)dge slong gi dge 'dun la yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur ⑩byas te/ tha ma'i nyin par sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das la na bza' 'bum ri ba phul lo/ /dge slong gzhan dag la yang re re la ras zung re phul nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 7smon lam btab ste/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba ⑫'dis na 8bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i8/ kha lo sgyur 8ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/74—107

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyod 0)'jig rten long ba 'dren ②pa med pa/ ston pa med par / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa / skyes bu 'dul ba'i ( nakha lo sgyur ④ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das legs (snyemathong zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// // las brgya tham pa/(6ska bam po sum cu ⑦gcig pa/ rin po che zhes bya ba ni/gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa nas ⑧ded dpon zhig gis zong khyer te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du chas so/ /ded dpon de yang mo ltas gtso bor (1)'dzin pa zhig ste/ de 0zong rnams rnga mo dang bong bu la sogs pa la bkal nas/ mnyan du yod pa'i phyi sgo chen mo las 0byung ste/lam po cher zhugs nas des sems 'di lta bu bskyed de/ gal te bdag rgya mtsho chen po'i 1gyenang nas/ nye zho med par bde bar 'ongs te/ rgya mtsho'i gru bo che'i don grub nas/ phyir 'khor bar gyur na sgo 'dir bdag gi 8sgo'i dus ston bya'o / /lam po che 'dir yang lam gyi dus ston bya'o zhes byas nas rgya mtsho chen por song ngo / /de nas de mirin po che'i gling bgrod par 8bsgrubs te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas 'gram du byung nas/ des bsams pa/ bdag 'gru bo ches ⑩rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du zhugs te/ des na bdag gis tunyenor chen po bsgrubs kyis4ge / bdag gis rgya mtsho'i 'gram 'di nyid du rgya mtsho'i lha rnams dang / gru 74—108

bo che la gnas pa'i lha rnams la bkur ste ①bya'o snyam nas/ des rgya mchosare 'gram de nyid du lha rnams la bkur ste chen po ②byas te/ mnyan du yod par chas so/ /de nas de mthar gyis rgyu zhing song song ba las/ mnyan du yod par phyin nas/ mnyan du yod par zong rnams bzhag ste/ des grong khyer gyi phyi chasgo chen po dudang / lam po che de'i ⑧lha rnams la mchod pa chen po byas nas/sbyin pa dag sbyin duzhing bsod nams dag byed pa la zhugs te/ des rin po che'i phung po chen po ⑦spungs nas/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dang / spyod pa pa ⑧dang kun tu rgyu ⑨dang / sdug cing phongs ⑩pa dang / bkres 0pa rnams la sbyin pa byed pa la zhugs so8/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig 0pu'i lam ston pa/ rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya ④dang / ye shes la mnga' brnyes 8pa/ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag ⑩pa gsum la mkhas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/ rnam par thar par ⑩brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis tsoganas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la snyoms ⑩par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs 0pa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum/ mtshan dus gsum ste0/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgudadu/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs 3shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar 'gyuraphyi/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa dudang / nyam nga ba dang / gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol / su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/0 su ni ngas ⑦74—109

ngan song stinas phyung ste/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhag ②par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ②bskyed duzin pa las yongs su smin ⑤par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin zin pa las duye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol bar bya/ su la ni sangs rgyas byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu yod par bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba ④med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa ded dpon 'di ⑧ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par sems bskyed par 'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams ⑨nas dge slong mang pos zham ring byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas / sgo de nyid nas mnyan du yod pa'i nang du gshegs pa dang / ded dpon des thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sku skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu 0rtsa gnyis kyis legs par brgyan cing spa 0bar byas pa mthong ngo —/ /mthong nas kyang de bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' ba skyes so/ /dga' ba skyes nas des 8rin po che spar gyis tibatab ste④/ bcom ldan 'das la gtor nas de dag sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ bcom ldan 'das kyi stong 8du lding khang lta bur chags te 'dug nas 0bcom ldan 'das gshegs na ⑩ni 'gro'o/ /74—110

gzhes ①na ni sdod do/ /de nas ded dpon des cho 'phrul de lta bu mthong nas/lhag par yang dga' ba skyes so/ /dga' ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ gsol pa/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i na bza' dang / zhal zas dang /gzims ②cha dang / gdan dang snyun gsos sridang / sman zong rnams sbyar bar 'tshal nadu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gnang bar ⑤mdzad du gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas ⑥ded dpon de la gnang ngo / /de nas ded dpon des bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas ⑦gnang bar rig nas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du yo byad thams cad sbyar te/ des ⑧sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zla ba gsum gyi bar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur ⑨byas nas/ tha ma'i nyin par sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol nas/bcom ldan 'das la na bza' 'bum ri ba phul lo/ /dge slong gzhan dag la yang re re la ras zung re phul nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na/ bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i0/ kha lo sgyur ⑩ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal btso/ ded dpon legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyod 'jig 74—111

rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ①kha lo sgyur ②ba / bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug tor can zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// //nor zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi ③mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag cig duganas pa des thabs ⑤zlar bab pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de ⑥de dang lhan cig tu 7rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am ⑧bcu lon pa dang / bu gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes ⑨pa zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston rgyas par byas nas/ rigs ⑩dang 'thun par ⑪ming btags te⑩/ de 'o ma dang zho dang mar dang zhun mar dang mar gyi nying gus bskyed tibasrings nas/ de gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe yi ge dang khong rtsis dang / shod dgod pa dang / lag rtsis dang dbyung ba dang / sba ba dang /dgram pa dang / gos brtag 8pa dang / nor bu brtag pa dang /8 rin po che brtag pa dang / spos brtag pa dang / sman brtag pa dang / glang po che ⑩brtag pa dang / rta ⑩brtag pa dang / go mtshon brtag pa la 8bslabs te/yi ge mkhas pa dang / klog mkhas pa dang / mdzangs yipa dang / bya ba la gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur topya / /de nas phyi zhig na des zong khyer te/ rgya mtsho'i tshunang du song ba las / rgya mtsho'i gru bo che'i don grub nas phyir 'ongs so/ /khyim bdag des 74—112

kyang khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin ①la brten nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa rnyed de/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so/ /de nas phyi zhig na khyim bdag des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim du spyan drangs ②te/ rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang bca' ba nigatsang ma bzang po mang pos tshim par byas nas/ ci bzhed pa bstabs te/chos nyan 0pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ⑤dang / khams dang shes pa dang /rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de nas ⑥khyim bdag de 'khor dang bcas pas/ stan de lanyid la 'khod ⑤bzhin du 'jig ①tshogs la lta ba'i tu )ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes yibacom nas/rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas yang dang yang du rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du 'gro zhing / bcom ldan 'das la chos nyan par byed do/ /bdag gi bu yang dang yang du dran par byed de8/ kye ma de yang 'dir 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad 8pa rnyed par gyur la/ chos 'di lta bu dag kyang thob ④na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas phyi zhig na khyim bdag gi bu de rgya mtsho'i gru bo che'i ⑩don grub ste/ phyir 'ongs nas des skyed tsomos tshal du rdzas rnams bzhag nas/ pha ma gnyis blta ⑩ba'i phyir shin tu rings par bdag gi khyim du song ba las/ de'i pha ma gnyis chos nyan tsopa'i phyir rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song nas/ khyim bdag gi bu des pha ma gnyis chos nyan ⑩pa'i phyir/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du song ngo 0zhes thos so/ /thos dunas kyang de yang rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal de nyid du song ste/ de der phyin 74—113

nas bdag gi ①pha ma gnyis blta bar bya'o snyam pa las/ khyim bdag gi bu des pha ma gnyis chos nyan gepa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug pa mthong ngo ske/ /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das chag la ba der song ste phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ pha ma gnyis kyi mgul nas 'jus nas chos nyan ④pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u de'i mdun du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spro ba skye bar du'agyur ba'i gtam bka' stsal to/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu khye'u de 0bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'dod pa skyes so/ /de nas khyim bdag de bcom ldan 'das las chos thos nas / bu dang lhan cig tu bdag gi khyim du song ngo / /der song nas de gnyis kyis bu de la smras pa/ bu khyod kyis rgya mtsho chen po'i nang ⑦nas bdag cag gnyis la ci zhig khyer te 'ongs/ khye'us dusmras pa/ rin po che rin thang che ba dag btsal ①te mchis so/ /pha ma gnyis kyis de la smras pa/ bu khyod kyis ni rgya mtsho'i nang du song nas sdug bsngal stong phrag grangs med ⑩pa myong ste/ rin po che tha mal pa dag khyer te 'ongs so/ /bdag cag gis ni 'di nyid na 'dug bzhin yidu/ tshegs chung ngus rin po che rin thang chen po dag rnyed do/ /khye'us smras pa/ 'o na tshegs chung ngus rnyed pa'i rin po che tsodag ci 'dra ba blta bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas pha ma gnyis kyis de la bdag cag nyid 0kyi yon tan rgyas par brjod do/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu khye'u de lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs tsol mgo bos phyag 'tshal ⑫74—114

te / chos nyan ①pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i rkyen du 'tsham pa'i ②chos bstan to/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu des/bcom ldan 'das kyi gtam gyi mjug nirdzogs par rig nas/ stan las langs te / bla gos phrag pa gcig 0tu gzar phyinas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de dulogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /zla ba gsum gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i na bza' dang / zhal zas dang / gzims ⑦cha dang / gdan dang ske/ snyun gsos nidang / sman zong rnams sbyar khyabar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag gi bu de la cang mi gsung bas gnang 8ngo / /de nas khyim bdag gi bu des bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bas gnang bar rig nas/rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du yo byad thams cad sbyar yite/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la ⑩zla ba gsum gyi bar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas nas/ tha ma'i nyin par sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das la na bza' 'bum ri ba phul lo/ /dge slong gzhan dag la yang re re la 8ras zung re phul nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na ④bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i 8kha lo sgyur tsob/ bla na med pa lha 74—115

dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ces byas sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis khye'u de la bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag gi bu legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyod 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ①kha lo sgyur ②ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu rlabs zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so// //stobs phrog ces (kyebya ba ni/ gleng gzhi byamanyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/de'i tshe byang phyogs kyi pan 0tsa la'i durgyal po dang / lho phyogs kyi pan 0tsa la'i rgyal po gnyis phan tshun ⑧mi 'thun par gyur te/ dus dus su skye bo phal po che kha 'dog par byed khyado/ /de gnyis kyi ⑩mdza' bo bshes shing gcugs yipa ni/rgyal po gsal rgyal yin te/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsams pa/ bdag gis thabs ci lta bu zhig gis de gnyis bsdum ⑩par bya snyam nas/ de'i blo skyes pa/bcom ldan 'das ni ma dul ba dul 8ba yin na8/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba gdab tsobo snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ⑩ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa byang phyogs kyi pan 8tsa la'i rgyal po dang / lho phyogs kyi pan ⑫tsa la'i rgyal po gnyis phan tshun mi 'thun par gyur te/ de gnyis kyis dus dus su skye bo phal po che kha 'dog par bgyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das ni ma dul 74—116

ba dul ①ba lags na thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ de gnyis kyi khon ②sbyang ba'i slad du nan tan mdzad du ②gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi gsung bas ④gnang ngo / /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de(snye/ rjes su yi rangs ⑥nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas ⑦song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das ⑧rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te/ byang phyogs kyi yul pan 6)tsa la dang / lho phyogs kyi yul pan 0tsa la gnyis kyi bar mtshams 7su gshegs te bzhugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas de dag 'thab par sems pa de lta bur byin gyis brlabs tunyesol/ /de nas byang phyogs kyi pan 8tsa la'i rgyal po dang / lho phyogs kyi pan 8tsa la'i rgyal po gnyis kyis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi go bskon 8nas g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir/ so so nas drangs so/ /de dag g.yul 'gyed par brtsams tsopa las/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus de gnyi gas ⑩rang rang pham ste ma 8nus nas/gzhan gyis thub par mthong ste7/ de gnyis so so nas shing rta re re la zhon te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/0 bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do0/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang ci nas de gnyis gcig dugis gcig 0mi mthong bar byin gyis phyibarlabs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa 'di gnyis las gcig ⑤ni nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /gcig gis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par sems bskyed par 74—117

'gyur ro snyam du dgongs nas/ gcig la ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i ①gtam gsungs so/ /gcig la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la spro bar 'gyur ba'i gtam gsungs so/ /de nas lho phyogs kyi pan ②tshu la'i rgyal po stan ②las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig 0tu gzar dunas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de dulogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ⑦bdag ④legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ⑨ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob ⑦tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yidage slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ⑩ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de la lung yang phog ste/ des kyang brtson pa dang bsgrub 0pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /byang phyogs kyi pan 8tsa la'i rgyal po yang stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig 8tu gzar tshunas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 0logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /zla ba gsum gyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i na bza' dang / zhal zas dang gzims 'cha dang / gdan dang / snyan gsos ⑪dang / sman zong rnams sbyar bar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la gnang bar 0mdzad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang phyogs kyi pan 0tsa la'i rgyal po la yang cang ⑤mi gsung bas tsoganang ngo / /de nas byang phyogs kyi pan ④tsa la'i rgyal pos/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ducang tsomi gsung bas 74—118

gnang bar rig nas/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun rang gi yul du spyan drangs te/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la ①sgra ba gsum gyi bar du yo byad thams cad sbyar nas/ yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur ②byas te/ tha ma'i nyin par sangs rgyas la ①sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das la na bza' 'bum ri ba phul lo/ /dge slong gzhan dag la yang re re la ras zung re phul nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab ste/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na ④bdag 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i dukha lo sgyur dub/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su gyur cig ④ces byas sol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis pan nitshu la'i rgyal po de la bka' stsal pa/rgyal po chen po legs so legs so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na rgyal po chen po khyod 'jig rten long ba 'dren pa med pa ston pa med par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i ⑨ba lo sgyur ⑩ba / bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /las brgya tham pa las/sdom 0gyi tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa rdzogs so8// //74—119

sdom ni/ bu dang ri yi ①gcong rong glud/ /'thab dang rnyis bzung ②gong ma sreg /phag dudang mi rgod sha za dang / /dbang po'i mgo ni tha ma yin/ /bu zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ bram ze zhig gnas te④/ des thabs zlar bab pa las chung ma blangs te/ de de dang lhan cig tu ⑤cu zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las/phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nasaX/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang /khye'u ⑦gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la ⑧mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston rgyas par byas stinas/ rigs dang 'thun par ⑩ming btags te/'o ma dang zho dang mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus yibaskyed bsrings so/ /'dod pa rnams ni tshwa 8chu dang 'dra ste/ ci 8tsam du bsten ④pa de tsam du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyis kyang mthar gyis bram ze'i 8bu gcig nas ⑩gnyis nas bdun gyi bar du byung nas/ de rnams rigs dang 'thun par ⑩ming btags te/ 'o ma dang zho dang / mar dang zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus yibaskyed bsrings te⑩/ de dag gang gi tshe cher skyes pa 0de'i tshe yi ge dang bram ze'i spyod lam dang / spyod pa dang / oṃ zhes bya ba dang / bho zhes bya ba dang / gtsang sbra dang / cho ga dang / thal ba blang ba dang 0/ ril ba thogs pa dang / nges brjod kyi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi durig byed dang —/ snyan 0tshig gi rig byed dang / srid srung gi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin bya ba dang / mchod sbyin byed du gzhug pa dang / sbyin pa dang ④/ blang ba dang li/ kha ton bya ba 'dang / kha ton slob tu gzhug pa'i thabs bslabs sh+yinas / las rnam pa drug la mkhas pa'i bram zer gyur to/ /de nas phyi zhig na 74—120

bram ze des bu de dag thams cad khyim phub ste/ bram ze de'i khyim na nor ci yod pa de dag ①thams cad so sor bgos nas bu de dag la byin no/ /de nas phyi zhig na bram ze de'i ②chung ma yang shi bram ze de ①yang rgas te mig gis ④mi mthong bar gyur nas/ de bu de rnams kyis khyim nas bskrad 0de/ de gzhan yidag gi khyim du slong 0zhing 'tsho bar byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig nipu'i lam ston pa/ rnam pa gnyis kyi ⑨zhes bya dang / ye ⑩shes la mnga' brnyes pa/ ma 'dres pa'i dran par 7nye bar gzhag 8pa gsum la mkhas pa / mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ 'gro ba lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched ⑩drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 8'jug pa dgu la snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs 8pa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgud/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs ⑩shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyur/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs pa ⑩dang / nyam nga ba dang / gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol8/su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas ⑩ngan song nas phyung ste/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang / 'bras bu la gzhag zhu )par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying 0ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed pa las 74—121

bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/① su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin ①zin pa las ye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol bar bya/ su la ②ni sangs rgyas byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu yod par bya snyam du ye shes dugazigs pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rigs kyi bu de gdul duba'i dus la bab par dgongs nas/ snga dro chos gos dang sham thabs gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas/ mnyan ⑦du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs te/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod par gshegs pa na/① bram ze rgas shing 'khogs la gtugs pa/ khar nib dang snod thogs shing gzhan dag gi 6)khyim du slong ba de ⑩gzigs so/ /gzigs nas ⑫bram ze de la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze rgas shing 'khogs ⑩la gtugs pa/ khyod ci'i phyir khar 8ba dang snod thogs shing / gzhan gyi khyim du slong zhing 'dugatso/bram zes gsol pa/ kye ma 8gi ta ma bdag gi bu bdun mchis te/ de rnams bdag gis gsos nas bskyed ⑩bsrings nas/ thos pas kyang mthar phyin par bgyis 0te bzhag nas/ mchis brang dang bcas te btsems te tsobadag gi khyim na ci bdog pa de dag thams cad kyang bdag gis so sor bgos te stsal na()/de rnams kyis bdag khyim nas bskrad pas na/ khar (nyeb dang snod thogs shing /gzhan dag gi khyim du slong 0zhing rgyu bar bgyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze khyod kyis nga las dutshigs su bcad pa bslabs te/ kun chub par byas la/ bu de rnams 'khor gyi nang na 'khod dupa 74—122

las bsgrags ①par nus sam/ bram zes gsol pa/ kye ma (gyigi ta ma bdag gis rngo thogs zhes ①so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ gang dag btsas nas dgar 'gyur ba④/ /gang phyir nor ni kun bsags pa/ /de dag bdag gis tshems ⑤dang sbyar/ /bdag ni khyim nas bskrad par gyur/ / nor zad pas ni yigang dag gis/ /bdag spangs ⑦de dag de na ⑧min/ /srin po bu yi ⑨cha lugs can/ /pha pha zhes brjod de mi brjid⑩/ /rta rgan zho sha zad ⑩pa bzhin/ /na tshod yal bar gyur pa na/ /gzhon nu rnams kyis 'pha rgan zhig /gzhan gyi khyim du slong bar gyur/ /rten til ma phan bu rnams ④pas/ bdag gi khar 8ba 'di bdam ⑩ste/ / khar ba 'di yi ⑩yon tan mthus/ /ba lang rdung zhing 'ong ba tsodang / /sbrul dang khyi yiza zlog 0par byed/ /mun pa'i nang na 0mdun du 'gro/ /ya nga'i gnas su tshod kyang rig /rdeg 'chos dun yang bdag la rtonadu/ /de nas bram ze des bcom ldan 'das kyi ④tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa 'di dag thos nas/ bu rnams kyi 'khor du song ste brjod nas/ bu rnams kyis de thos ma thag tu pha la bzod par ⑤gsol te⑩/ snga mkho bzhin du khyim gyi bdag por bzhag go/ /de nas phyi ⑩zhig na/ bram ze des bsams pa/ bdag gi dpal dang skal ba dang ldan pa gang ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad ni/ bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de'i bka' drin yin natso/ ma la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das gi ta ma de ⑥bshos gsol la/ rin thang che ba'i na bza' dbul 0bar bya gor ma chag snyam nas / bram ze des bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs te/ bza' ba dang bca' ba ⑥gtsang dum bzang po mang po dag gsol nas/ rin thang che ba'i na bza' phul 74—123

lo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de dang bu de rnams la de dag ①dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de nas ②byam ze de 'khor dang bcas pas/stan ①de dag nyid la 'khod ④bzhin du/ 'jig tshogs la lta duba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des skyobaden pa mthong nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nasartsi/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de nilogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ⑨ba dang /bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob 0tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyad pa spyod par ⑩'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze de la 8dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de la lung yang phog ste0/des kyang brtson pa dang bsgrub 8pa dang / 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bram ze rgas shing 'khogs la gtugs 8pa 'di bu rnams kyis khyim nas bskrad nas/ 'di ⑩bcom ldan 'das kyis thabs dang ldan pas/ snga mkho'i gnas su slar sor chud par mdzad nas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang bram ze 'di 0bu rnams kyis rang gi khyim nas bskrad pa na(ste/ 'di ngas ⑩snga mkho'i gnas su 74—124

bzhag nas/ bsam ①gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la ②ji ltar gnas par byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/grong khyer tsam pa zhes bya ba na/ khyim bdag cig gnas pa de la snga phyir ①bu bdun byung nas de dag gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur nas/ khyim bdag des bu de dag thams cad khyim phub ste/de'i ④ci bdog pa de dag ⑤thams cad kyang so sor bgos nas/ de rnams la byin no/ /khyim bdag de yang rgas shing 'khogs la gtugs par gyur nas/ de bu de ①rnams kyis khyim nas ⑦bskrad de/ de rgas bzhin gzong khyer te yul gzhan du chas so/ /de'i tshe dka' thub kyi gnas zhig na/ drang srong rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba zhig gnas te/ dka' thub kyi gnas de'i 'dab cig ①tu de 'ongs nas/ drang srong des khyim bdag de mthong nas smras pa/ khyim bdag rgas shing 'khogs la gtugs pa khyod ci'i phyir yul gzhan du chas te 'gro/ de nas khyim bdag des gtam de drang srong de la rgyas par bsnyad ⑩do/ /de nas drang srong gis smras pa/ khyim bdag khyod ngas ci nas bu de rnams kyis yimachod pa dang rim gro byed par 'gyur ba 8de ltar bya'o 0zhes smras nas/ drang srong des khyim bdag de phyir zlog ④ste rang gi gnas su khrid nas/ drang srong des de'i bu rnams la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na 8bu de rnams kyis pha de 8khyim du bos ⑩nas/ snga mkho bzhin du 8bzhag go/ /de nas khyim bdag des snga ma'i drin lan bsab pa'i phyir drang srong de yikhyim du zas 0byin nas / de'i thad du rab tu byung ste/ de rab tu phyung zho nyanas bsam gtan bzhi dang —/ mngon par shes pa tsolnga bskyed do/ /dge slong dag ji 0snyam du sems/74—125

de'i tshe drang srong du gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni bram ze 'di kho na yin no/ /de'i bur gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ①ni bu 'di dag kho na yin te②/ de'i tshe yang 'di rgas shing 'khogs la dugatugs par gyur nas / khyim nas bskrad pa las ngas thabs dang ldan pas snga dumakho'i gnas su bcug ste ⑤bzhag nas/ dubasam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la gnas par byas so/ da ltar yang 'di rgas shing 'khogs la gtugs par gyur nas / khyim nas bskrad pa las ngas thabs dang ldan pas snga mkho'i gnas su bcug ste ⑦bzhag nas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag nigo/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la 'di rab tu byung ste/ der 7tshe gcig ⑦tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/ dbang po rnams yongs su smin par byas pa des na / da ⑩ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //ri zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag cig gnas pa des/ thabs zlar bab pa las chung ma blangs 8nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu 8rtse zhing dga' la 8dga' mgur spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang / khye'u tigazugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la ⑩mdzes pa zhig btsas tete/ rigs dang 'thun par ⑩ming btags yinas/ de yi'o ma dang / zho dang /mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus 0bskyed bsrings te/ de ⑥gang gi tshe phyocher skyes pa de'i tshe yi ge dang / khong rtsis dang / shod dgod pa 74—126

dang ske/ lag rtsis dang / dbyung ba dang / sba ba dang / dgram ①pa dang /gos brtag pa dang / nor bu brtag pa dang / rin po che brtag pa dang /spos brtag pa ②dang / sman brtag pa dang / glang po che brtag pa dang / rta brtag pa dang / go mtshon brtag pa la ③bslabs te/ yi ge mkhas pa dang /klog mkhas pa dang / mdzangs 0pa dang / bya ba la gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs ⑤pa dang / brtag pa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur toyi/ /de nas phyi zhig na de phas ⑦mdza' sde rnams kyi nang du btang ngo / /mdza' sde bo de rnams ni lta dub dang / 'dod pa tha dad pa po)phan tshun mi 'thun par smra ba sha stag ste/gang dag ⑩gang la dga' ba de dag de'i bsngags pa rjod ⑩par byed do/ /khyim bdag gi bu de ni tsorang bzhin gyis mdzangs 8pa zhig ste/ thams cad kyi gzhung lugs 'dri bar byed na/ la la ci zer/ la la ci zer bar gyur nas/ lta ba'i rnam pa de dag mi 'dod cing / mi bzod la rung bar mi 'dzin to/ /de nas phyi zhig na dge bsnyen zhig gis sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa yang dag pa ci ④lta ba bzhin du brjod nas/ de thos ma thag tu khyim bdag gi bu des dris pa/sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sgra byung ba 'di dag ni 8sngon ma byung na sangs rgyas zhes bya ba de su zhig /de nas dge bsnyen des de dang 'thun pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod do/ /de nas tshukhyim bdag gi bu de bcom ldan 'das blta bar ⑩'dod par gyur to/ / de nas 8des thams cad bor te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos nyan ⑩pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la 0de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de thos nas khyim bdag 74—127

gi bu de bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur to①/ /de nas khyim bdag gi bu des bcom ldan 'das kyi gtam mjug ⑤rdzogs par rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod cing rjes su yi rangs te③/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas④/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑤thad nas song ngo / /de nas phyi zhig na de sbyin pa gtong ⑥ba'i sems skyes la/khyim na ni ci yang mi bdog par mthong nas/ de'i blo skyes pa/ bdag rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du song la/ gal te bdag gi ⑦lan cig ⑤tsam rin po che'i gling bgrod pa bsgrub 0nus par gyur na yang / de ltar ⑩na bde blag tu sbyin pa dag sbyin (skyezhing bsod nams dag kyang byed 8nus so snyam nas/ tshong 8pa lnga 8brgya tsam dang lhan cig shetu zong khyer te/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du song nas/ des rin po che'i gling bgrod pa bsgrubs te/ phyir 'dzam bu'i 8gling logs su chas pa las / de dag ⑩rlung mi bzod 8pa byung nas/ des 7gru bo che de ri'i gcong rong zhig tu btsangs ⑥ so/ /de nas rgya mtsho'i 0dus rlabs phyir log pa dang /tshong pa de dag 'jigs shing ()skrag ste/ bdag cag ni shi zin no/ /bdag cag gi srog ni med zin no/ /da bdag cag la dga' dub byed pa dang / srog phangs ④pa sbyin pa su yod ces 'dzer to(nye/ /de nas ded dpon gyis smras pa/ma 'jigs shig ma tso'ajigs shig /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su deng 0shig dang / des bdag cag phongs pa dang / dkos 'thag pa dang gnod pa dang 0phrad pa las skyabs mdzad par 'gyur ro zhes byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu tshong pa de ( )rnams sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ste/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ni 0'di lta ste/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da 74—128

ltar byung ba ci yang mi gzigs pa dang / mi mkhyen pa dang ①/ thugs su ma chud pa ma mchis na②/ kye ma btsun pa bdag cag phongs shing dkos ①thag la gnod pa dang phrad pa rnams la ①skyabs mdzad du gsol/ srog phangs pa stsal du gsol 0zhes byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas gru ⑥de rang nyid ri'i gcong ⑦rang de nas phyir log ste/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bur byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas de dag rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du byung nas/ mthar gyis mnyan du yod par song ⑧ste/ mnyan du yod par rdzas rnams bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song 6)ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/tu ) bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'o 7byas nas/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag cag la dka' 8ba mdzad mdzad hunyepa lags/ srog phangs pa stsol tsob lags 8so zhes gsol nas/ chos mnyan ⑩pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ⑩dang /khams dang / shes pa dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/ de dang 'thun pa'i 8chos bstan te/ de nas tu)ded dpon la sogs pa tshong pa lnga brgya rngo )po rnams kyis stan de 0nyid la 'khod bzhin du/ 'jig tshogs el lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de rnams kyis bden pa mthong nas/ gsol pa/btsun pa bdag cag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung dub dang —/ bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob 69tu rung na/bdag cag kyang 'bacom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal 74—129

lo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la ①dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ②ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de dag la lung yang phog nas / de dag gis kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrub ④pa dang /'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa ⑤nyid mngon sum du byas te/ de dag dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar ⑥mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan spangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/rig pas sgo tsonga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti ⑧la mi lta ba dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed ⑨pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to0/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol ⑩pa/ btsun pa tshong pa lnga brgya po 'di rnams ded dpon 'di la 8brten te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jigs pa chen po las bskyabs yinas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug ④pa grub pa dang —/ bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang tshong pa lnga brgya po tso'adi rnams kyisatso/ ded dpon 'di la ⑩brten te/ngas 'jigs pa chen po las bskyabs tsonas/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la ci ltar bkod pa de ⑩nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na dka' 0thub kyi gnas zhig na/drang srong 0mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba zhig 74—130

gnas te/ de yang bā rā ṇa sī na gnas pa'i skye bo mang pos bkur ster ①bya ba dang ske/ bla mar bya ba dang / ri mor bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba zhig go/ /de nas phyi zhig na bā rā ṇa sī na tshong pa lnga brgya tsam gyis/ drang srong de ②la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gnang du song ④ste/ de dag gi ⑤rin po che'i gling bgrod pa bsgrubs yinas/ phyir 'dzam bu'i 7gling logs su chas pa las/ de dag gi gru bo che rgya mtsho'i dus rlabs ⑤kyis thang la ⑨'phangs nas / de dag ⑩der 'jigs shing skrag par gyur te/ bdag cag 'tsho ba'i dus skabs med do snyam nas/ de dag lha rnams la gsol ba 'debs par byed do / /de nas ded dpon gyis smras pa/ bdag cag gis lha gzhan dag la gsol ba gdab ⑩ci dgos/ bdag cag drang srong de nyid el skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o/ /'on kyang des ⑩bdag cag phongs shing dkos ④thag pa dang /gnod pa dang phrad pa la 8skyabs byed par 'gyur zhing / srog phangs ⑩pa sbyin par byed do/ de nas de ⑩thos ma thag tu tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag drang srong de kho na la skyabs su dong ngo / /de nas drang srong de la dga' ba'i lhas drang srong de la sbran yinas/ drang srong des tshong pa lnga brgya po de dag rdzu 'phrul gyis rgya mtsho chen po'i nang nas phyung ste/ rang gi dka' thub kyi tshal du bkod do/ /de nas tshong pa rnams kyis bsams pa/ bdag cag gson por gyur pa ci yang rung ba de dag thams cad ni drang srong 'di'i mthu yiyin no snyam nas/ sbyin pa dag byin duzhing bsod nams dag byas nas/ thams cad drang srong de'i thad du rab tu byung ste/ de dag der rab tu byung nas/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed 0do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe drang 74—131

srong du gyur pa 0)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa ②de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe ded dpon du gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshong par gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ni/ tshong pa 'di ①rnams kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang 'di rnams kyis ④ded dpon 'di kho na la brten nas/ ngas 'jigs pa chen po las bskyabs (7te/ bsam gtan bzhi yidang / mngon par shes pa lnga la bkod do / /da ⑦ltar yang 'di rnams kyis ⑧ded dpon 'di la ⑨brten nas/ ngas 'jigs pa chen po las bskyabs te⑩/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod do/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la 'di dag thams cad rab tu byung (meste/ der 'di rnams kyis tshe gcig 8tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/dbang po rnams yongs su smin 8par byas pa des na/ da ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //glud ④ces bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na khyim bdag phyug cing nor mang la/ longs spyod che ba yongs su 'dzin pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang mnyam pa/ rnam thos kyi bu'i nor dang 'gran pa zhig gnas pa des thabs zlar bab pa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu 8rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /khyim bdag de yang bu mi gshin ⑩pa zhig ste/ bu dang bu mo btsas so cog ⑩'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag de'i bsen tunyeni/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa yin te/ des khyim bdag de skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la gnas par byas nas/ sbyin pa dag tunyesbyin pa'i bgo bsha' byed du bcug go/ /74—132

de nas phyi zhig na khyim bdag de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang / khye'u 6)gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas nas/ khyim bdag des bsams pa/ thabs ci ltar byas na/ khye'u 'di 0tshe ring bar 'gyur zhig gu snyam nasagli/ de'i blo skyes pa/ 'phags pa ma 'gags pa 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che zhing bsod nams dang ldan pa/ che bar grags pa yin pas na/ 'di la ④bdag gi ༅bu 'di (6)g.yog tu phul na6)/ 'di'i mthus tshe ring bar 'gyur yang srid do snyam nas/ pha ma gnyis kyis khye'u ⑧de po)tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa la phul nas/ de nyin gcig 7bzhin du rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du khrid cing gso bar byed la/ dge slong (7gi cha lugs su bcug nas / dge slong dag dang lhan cig tu bsod snyoms la ()rgyu bar byed do/ /de nas de gang gi tshe shed bye bar gyur pa de'i tshe/ khyim bdag des sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun khyim du spyan drangs nas/ rang gi lag nas bza' ba dang / bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po mang 3)pos tshim par byas te/ci bzhed pa bstabs nas/ khye'u de'i glud 8du gser dngul mang po phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang khyim bdag de la chos kyi gtam gyis 8yang dag par bstan⑩ / yang dag par 'dzin du bcugati /yang dag par gzengs yonyebastod/yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas/ gdan las 67bzhengs te gshegs so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhugashegs nas/ khyim bdag des khye'u de'i chos gos tshon tshucan rnams phud deX/ khyim 0pa'i gos dang rgyan rnams bskon ④no/ /de nas de'i khyim pa'i gos dang rgyan bskon 3rna cog ( gyimi snang bar gyur te6)/ chos gos tshon can de dag du'aba' zhig byung bar gyur to(rte/ /de nas gang gi tshe cha lugs 74—133

de bsgyur ①ma nus pa de'i tshe/ dge slong gi cha lugs su ②'dug bzhin du gso ②bar byed de①/ khyim de nyid du ne'u ldangs 0kyi grogs po lnga brgya dang lhan cig tu yi ge slob tu bcug go/ /de nas de rang gi khyim der yang dga' ba med na/gzhan du lta ci smos te/ gtsug lag khang 'ba' zhig tu 'gro 'dod par gyur to//de nas khyim bdag des bu de gtsug lag khang du khrid nas de nyid du gsos duso/ /de nas des ⑦gtsug lag khang de nyid du bstan bcos nithams cad rtogs ⑨par gyur nas/ de phyir khyim du 'gro mi 'dod do0/ /gtsug lag khang du yi'adug bzhin du des rgyun du zhugs 8pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas pha ma la gsol te/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa'i thad tsodu rab tu byung nas/ bsnyen par ④rdzogs te/ tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pas de la lung yang 7phog nas/ des kyang ⑩brtson pa dang bsgrub ⑩pa dang / 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nasayi/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so / /( )dgra bcom par gyur nas bsams pa/ bdag gis 'dul dubar 'gyur ba 'ga' lta ci yod snyam ste0/ des bltas na 'badag gi 'pha ma la sogs pa ne'u ldangs phyokyi grogs po lnga brgya 'dul bar gyur pa ⑤mthong nas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te⑩/ rang gi khyim du pha ma gnyis kyi mdun nas sa brtol 0te byung ngo / /de nas de mthong ma thag tu pha ma gnyis kyis 'de la shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas chos nyan ⑦pa'i phyir mdun du 'dug go/ /de nas des pha ma de gu gnyis kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal sh+yidang —/ khams dang shes pa dang / rang bzhin rtogs nas de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na 'pha ma de gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dustan de dag nyid 74—134

la 'khod bzhin du 'jig ①tshogs la ②lta ba'i ri'i 0rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes ④rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/bden pa mthong nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab ⑤pa'i gzhi rnams la bkod de / sbyin pa dang dusbyin pa'i bgo bsha' yang 9)byed du bcug nas/ khyim de khron pa dang 'dra bar byas te bzhag go/ /des ne'u ldangs ④kyi grogs po lnga brgya po de dag 0skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi ⑩rnams la bkod do/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa khyim bdag gi bu 'dis skyelas ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes la/ bcom ldan 'das kyang 'dis mnyes par bgyis te⑩/ mi mnyes par (nyam bgyis nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan ④pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis te⑩/ 'di nyid la brten nas pha ma la sogs pa dang / ne'u ldangs ⑩kyi grogs po lnga brgyas ⑩bden pa tsomathong bar gyur yite/ bcom ldan 'das kyang 'dis mnyes par bgyis te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis dulags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang las gyur to/ /gsol pa/ btsun pa 'di rnams kyis smon lam gang du btab lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgus 0tshe lo nyi 'khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i tsokha lo sgyur ④ba / bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 74—135

'das 'od srung zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung stodhi/ de'i tshe grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag cig gnas pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i bu gzugs bzang zhing blta ②na sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ des ①yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la dad pa rnyed ④nas/skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs so/ /de gang gi ⑤nyin par btsas pa de 6)kho na'i nyin par khyim bdag gzhan gyi bu lnga brgya yang btsas te/gang gi tshe de dag mecher skyes pa de'i tshe brtag (kyepa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur te6) / de nas de dag so so'i pha ma rnams kyis mdza' sde'i nang du btang 0ngo / /de nas phyi zhig na dpyid tunyekyi dus su mdza' sde bo de rnams skyed 8mos tshal ⑩shing ljon pa yal ga 'khrigs 8shing / me tog rgyas pa'i nang du 'gro 'dod par gyur nas / ne'u 8zla rnams kyis khye'u de sngon du btang ⑩bar 'dod de/ khyod sngar song la bza' ba dang bca' ⑩ba dag sta gon tunyegyis shig dang / bdag cag kyang don (1)grub nas 'ong ngo zhes byas so/ /de nas de zhu der 0song nas bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po zhunyamang po dag sta gon 0byas so/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'khor dang bcas pa yang (stes phyogs de logs nas / bā rā ṇa sīr bsod snyoms la chas te gshegs so/ /de nas khye'u ⑤des thag ring po zhig nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'khor dang bcas pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang des bsams pa/ yon gnas kyi mchog 'di lta bu bsod snyoms la chas te gshegs la/ bdag gis kyang tshegs chung ngus bza' ba dang ( nyabaca' ba dag sbyar ba 0yod na/ bdag gis je tsoyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'khor dang bcas pa la bshos ⑦gsol 74—136

la / de'i 'og tu bdag gis grogs po rnams kyi bza' ba dang bca' ba 6)gzhan dag ②sbyar bar bya'o snyam nas/ des yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 'khor dang bcas pa skyed ①mos tshal de nyid kyi nang ④du spyan drangs te⑤/bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po mang 6)pos tshim par byas te⑦/ ci bzhed pa bstabs nas chos nyan ⑧pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis de la chos kyi gtam gyis yang dag par bstan⑨/ yang dag par 'dzin du bcug /yang dag par gzengs ⑩bstod / yang dag par dga' bar mdzad nas/ gdan las bzhengs te gshegs so/ /de nas khye'u des ⑩mdza' sde bo rnams kyi phyir bza' ba dang bca' ba gzhan dag sta gon 'byed pa la zhugs so/ /de nas mdza' sde bo de rnams skyed tsomos tshal der lhags nas/ bdag cag gi bza' ba dang bca' ba sta tsogon 8byas pa de dag thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung 'khor dang bcas pa la phul lo zhes thos so/ /de thos ma thag tu de dag shas cher 8khros te/ de dag khros nas khye'u de bsad yonapar byas so/ /de nas khye'u de 'jigs shing skrag par gyur nas/ drang srong smra bar song ste/ des gnas de nas 8pha ma gnyis la bzlugs tetu)/ pha ma gnyis kyis 'thab ( )mo zhi bar bya bar brtsams pa tshulas/ zhi bar byed ma nus nas(nya/ khye'u des pha ma gnyis la gsol te0/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la rab tu byung ngo / /de tshurab tu byung nas sde snod gsum lobs te (nyerig (9pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang 0ldan pa'i chos smra bar gyur nas/ des 'pha ma gnyis skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la bkod nas/ sbyin pa 74—137

dag dang 6)/ sbyin pa'i bgo bsha' byed du bcug go/ /de nas mdza' sde bo de ②rnams kyis de rab tu byung ba mthong nas/ 'gyod pa skyes te/ bdag cag gis ma legs pa ①byas so/ /snyam nas/ de dag gis de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/bzod pa gsol to/ /de las duskyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams kyang ⑤blangs so/ /de nas phyi zhig na dge slong de nad kyis thebs nas/ de rtsa ba dang sdong bu dang / lo ma dang me tog dang / 'bras bu'i sman rnams kyis rim gro byas kyang / sos par byed ma nus te/ des 'chi kur yismon lam btab pa / kye ma 'di ltar bdag ⑦gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la tshe gcig ⑧ku tshangs par spyod pa spyad khyikyang yon tan gyi tshogs ci yang ma thob na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye bar shog shig /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma kyilung bstan pa tunyegang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la tunyerab tu 'byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /de'i 8pha ma gnyis dang mdza' sde bo de rnams 8kyang de'i mdun du 'dug par gyur te/ de rnams kyis kyang thos nas smon lam btab pa/ bdag cag kyang khyod kho na la brten 8te/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag cag rnams kyis mnyes ⑩par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par 8byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji tu)snyam du sems/ de'i tshe sde snod dugasum par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/74—138

khyim bdag gi bu 'di kho na yin no/ /de'i tshe pha ma gnyis su gyur pa gang yin pa de gnyis ni da ltar gyi pha ma 'di ①gnyis kho na yin ②rna/ / de'i tshe mdza' sde bor gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ni/ da ltar gyi ne'u ldangs lnga brgya po 'di dag kho na yin no/ /③des der tshe gcig byatu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/ 'chi kur dusmon lam btab pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas/ gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes te/ dge slong dag nga duyang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang / shin tu mnyam pa dang shugs mnyam pa dang / mdzad pa ⑦mnyam pa dang / thabs mnyam pa brnyes ⑧par gyur nas/ 'dis nga mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par ma byas la/ nga nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ste/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so6)/ /der de'i pha ma gnyis dang mdza' sde ⑩bo de rnams kyis kyang smon lam btab pa des na⑩/ da ltar yang 'di kho na la ⑩brten tsonas/ 'di rnams kyis nga mnyes par byas te/mi mnyes par ma byas so// // las brgya tham pa/8 bam po sum cu tsoganyis pa/ 'thab pa ⑩zhes bya ba ni/gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te⑩/ de'i tshe yul ko sa la dang / yul ma ga ṅgā'i bar mtshams tson/ seng ge mthu rtsal bdo yib gnyis 'dug ste/ de gnyis de na 'dug pas/ skye bo mang po kha 'dog (3 par byed de/ 'drul ⑩bcad do/ /de gnyis kyis lam chod pas/ su yang lam der 'gro mi nus par gyur tos/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod 0pa gcig pu'i lam ston pa/rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya tsodang / ye shes la mnga' brnyes byapa/ ma 'dres pa'i 74—139

dran pa nye bar gzhag 6)pa gsum la mkhas pa/ mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa / 'gro ba lnga ②las rnam par grol ba/ skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan ⑧pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/ yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs ④pa rnams ni/ chos nyid kyis nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgud/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs ⑧shing 'dug /su ni nyam nga bar gyuradu/su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs ⑦pa dang / nyam nga ba dang / gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas dungan song nas phyung ste/ mtho ris dang / thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod ⑨pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las/'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug ⑩par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed ⑩pa las bskyed par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed zin pa las yongs su asmin par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams smin tu pa las ye shes kyi mtshon gyis brtol chabar bya/ su la ⑩ni sangs rgyas byung bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu yod par bya snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus rlabs ⑩yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis seng ge de gnyis 'dul ⑩ba'i dus la 74—140

bab par dgongs nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la dge slong rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā 0)phyogs su ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs kyis(2ri/ su bcom ldan 'das dang lhan cig tu ( geljongs rgyu zhing ④'gro 'dod pa de dag chos gos long (5)shig ces bsgo shig ces (6)bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das dbyar gnas shing / dbyar bzhugs nas/dge slong mang pos zham ring byas te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis mdun du bdar nas/ rgyal po'i khab tu chas te/ mthar gyis rgyu zhing gshegs gshegs nas / seng ge'i nags khung ⑦du byon nas/ seng ge de gnyis zas tshol du song nasong ba las/ de gnyis phrad nas 'thab par chas so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyang de gnyis la thugs brtse ba'i phyir mdun logs su gzhes 6)so/ /de nas thag ring po zhig nasakyi/ seng ge de gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang seng ge (nyaganyis khro ba'i nyustekun nas dkris tu pa med par gyur te/bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur nasabo/ de gnyis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan tshe'adas tshekyi zhal du blta nya 7zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs khyed (snyeganyis sngon gyi nyes par spyod pa'i las kyis dud 'gro'i nang du 17skyes na/ khyed ( snaganyis da ltar yang de pu lha'aba' zhig gi rgyu byed cing 'dug go/ /bzhin bzangs (snyeganyis 'di ltar 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag go/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med do/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /nga 3)la sems dga' bar gyis sageshig dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang bral bar 'gyur yang srid do zhes bka' 74—141

stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs so/ /de gnyis bcom ldan 'das las ①chos thos nas kha 'tshos so/ /dud 'gro'i skye ②gnas su skyes pa rnams ni me'i drod che ste/ bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' ba bskyed ②bzhin du shi nas lha'i nang du skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes dum thag pa ni/ chos nyid kyis sems rnam pa gsum skye bar 'gyur te/ bdag gang nas shi 'phos gang du skyekhya/las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas dud 'gro las shi 'phos pa dang / lha'i nang du skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa de gnyis rjokyis mthong ngo / /de nas de gnyis kyis bsam ⑦pa/ bdag cag gnyis zhag lon nas/ gzod bcom ldan 'das la ⑧blta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni/ bdag cag gnyis kyi cha ma yin gyil/ bdag cag gnyis zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la ⑩blta ba'i phyir 'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon seng ger gyur pa'i ⑩lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor 8dag cing mgul rgyan 8thogs pa/ lus do shal dang / se ④mo dos brgyan 8pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i cod pan can lus gur gum dang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang / spro 0ka la 0sogs pas byugs ⑫pa de gnyis kyis 8de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud pa la dang / pad ma dang ske/ ku mu da khyadang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā 0ra ba dag gis ⑫thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor tedu/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ chos nyan ④pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi tsospyan sngar 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de gnyis la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ de gnyis kyis chos 0thos nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te/74—142

de gnyis kyis ①bden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su song ngo / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / mdang sum ②mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'am/ lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gzhan 'ga' zhig /bcom ldan 'das la ①blta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag mdang sum ④mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po dubargya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'am/ lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gzhan 'ga' zhig nga ⑥blta ba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyisaX/ dge slong dag khyed nikyis nags khung dgon pa na/ seng ge gnyis phan tshun 'thab cing 'dug pa mthong ngamal/gsol pa/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ngas de gnyis la ⑩chos bstan te/ de gnyis kyis ting las chos thos nas kha 'tshos te/ de gnyis shi 'phos te dus las 'das pa las lha'i nang du skyes te lhar gyur nas/ nga'i thad du 'ongs te/ de gnyis la ngas chos bstan nas/ nga las 8chos thos pa des na/ de dag gis bden pa rnams mthong ste/ de gnyis kyis bden pa mthong nas8/ rang gi ④gnas su song ngo / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis seng ge 8de gnyis kyi khon ⑩byang bar mdzad de/ mtho ris dang thar pa thob par mdzad la/ yul 'khor gnyis kyi 'jigs pa bsal ⑩ba la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i 74—143

dus na yang ngas 'di gnyis kyi khon (1)byang bar byas nas/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la bkod de/ yul 'khor gnyis kyi (mi'ajigs pa yang ci ltar bsal ba de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na / yul kā 555shi'i (4)rgyal po tshangs pas byin dang / bi de ha'i rgyal po dbang chen sde gnyis phan tshun mi 'thun par gyur nas/ de gnyis kyis dus (9dus su skye bo phal po che kha 'dog par byed do/ /de nas phyi (6)zhig na de gnyis kyis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi (7)go bskon (8)nas/ g.yul 'gyed par 'dod pa'i phyir/ sa mtshams 99)na 'khod do/ /de gnyis 'khod pa'i 'dab na dka' thub kyi gnas zhig tshan/ drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba zhig gnas pa des/ de gnyis la snying brtse turnyeba'i phyir/steng gi nam mkha' la nyuge'ongs nas/ de gnyis kyi bar mtshams su 'dug go/ /de nas drang srong de mthong nas de gnyis kyi khro ba'i kun nas dkris turtepa med par gyur nas/ drang srong de la shas cher dga' bar gyur to/ /de gnyis dga' bar gyur nas/ drang srong de la smras pa/ bka' stsal pa ci mchis/ drang srong des smras pa/ khon byang bar 〉gyis shig /rgyal po de gnyis kyis smras pa/drang srong gis ci skad bka' stsal pa de bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes smras nas/mjal nyu5dum byas te/ drang srong gi rkang pa la phyag 'tshal nas/ chos nyan ⑩pa'i phyir/ drang srong gi mdun du 'dug go/ /drang srong des kyang de gnyis la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan to17/ / de nas 18rgyal po de gnyis kyis hu)so so'i bu rab rgyal sar bcug nas/ drang srong de nyid kyi zhu )thad du rab tu byung ste/bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed zhurtado/ /dge slong dag ji ni 74wa 144

snyam du sems/ de'i tshe drang srong du gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 6)pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de ni nga 0nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe kā (7shi'i rgyal po tshangs pas byin dang / bi de ha'i rgyal po dbang chen sder gyur pa gang yin pa de gnyis ni/ seng ge 'di gnyis kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang ngas 'di (4)gnyis kyi khon byang bar byas (5)rinas rab tu byung 6ste/ bsam gtan bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga ⑦bskyed do/ /da (8ltar yang ngas 'di (9)gnyis kyi khon byang bar yibyas nas/ mtho ris dang thar pa thob par 17byas so/ /gsol pa/btsun pa 'di gnyis kyis 12las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas seng ger skyes lags/ las ci bgyis na/ de nas shi 'phos nas lha'i nang du skyes la 'di gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'das pa'i las kyang yod / da ltar gyi las kyang yod de/ 'das pa'i las gang zhe na/sna yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la 'di gnyis dge bsnyen du gyur te/ kha mi mkhas pa desakyi/ 'di gnyis khros pas/ skye bo mang po la dud 'gro zhes bya ba'i tshig smras la/lha/ der 'di gnyis kyis tshe gcig tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bsrungs tshanas/ 'chi kur 7smon lam btab pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung 38gis/ bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji nyu9snyam du sems/ de'i tshe dge bsnyen du gyur pa gang yin pa ( )de gnyis ni/ seng ge 'di gnyis 27kho na yin te(22/ de gnyis 74—145

kyis der skye bo mang po la dud 'gro zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni dud 'gror skyes so/ /de gnyis kyis der tshe gcig tu skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams bsrungs ①nas/ 'chi kur ⑤smon lam btab pa des ni/ dge slong dag nga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang / shin tu mnyam pa dang / shugs mnyam pa dang / mdzad pa mnyam pa dang / thabs mnyam pa brnyes par gyur dunas/ 'di gnyis kyis nga mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par ma byas pa 'di ni 'das pa'i dus kyi las yin no/ /da ltar byung ba'i las gang zhe na/ 'di ciganyis seng ger gyur nas/ nga khrul sems dga' bar byas pa des na lha'i nang du skyes te/ 'di ni da ltar byung ba'i las yin no// // rnyis bzung ba ⑥zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan ⑦du yod pa na bzhugs te/de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ nags khrod cig ⑧na/ ri dgas kyi rngon pa dag cig khyagis ri dgas bshor ⑩pa'i phyir rgya dang rnyi dang / 'jol ⑩rlubs dang /rnyi tsomang po dag btsugs nas/ der ri dgas mang po zhig bzung ngo / /rngon pa de dag kyang nang par sngar langs te/ nags khrod der song tsonas/ de dag gis der ri dgas ci zin pa rnams mda' tso'aphangs te bsad nas/ de dag las nyung shas cig lus so/ /de'i tshe sa phyogs der bcom ldan 'das kyang gshegs so/ /de nas ri dgas de rnams dang ⑫/ rngon pa de rnams kyis thag ring po zhig nas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas/ rngon pa de dag bcom ldan 'das ga ⑩la ba der song ⑩ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 74—146

zhabs la mgo bos ①phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan ②pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go②ske/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de rnams kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal dudang / khams dang / shes pa dang / rang bzhin thugs su chud nas/de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na rngon pa de rnams kyis stan dude dunyid la 'khod bzhin du rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de dag gis bden pa mthong nas/ gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag cag tshulegs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung nizhing / dge slong gi dngos po 'thob ①tu rung na/ bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad ⑩par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'des kyis de dag la yidage slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ⑩ste/ bsnyen par rdzogs par ⑫mdzad nas/ de dag la lung yang phog ste/ de dag gis 8kyang brtson pa dang bsgrub 8pa dang / 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du ⑩byas so/ /ri dgas de rnams kyang bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bzhin du ⑩shi 'phos te/ dus las 'das nas lha'i nang du skyes so/ /lha'i bu'am lha'i bu mo skyes ma thag pa yini chos nyid kyis ⑩sems rnam pa gsum skye bar tshu'agyur te/ bdag gang nas shi 0'phos/ gang du skyes/las gang gis skyes snyam mo/ /de nas dud 'gro las shi 'phos dupa dang lha'i nang du skyes pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la sems dga' bar gyur pa 0de dag gis mthong ngo / /de nas de dag gis bsams pa/ bdag cag zhag lon nas gzod ④bcom 0ldan 'das la tsobalta ba'i phyir 'gro ba ni bdag cag gi cha ma yin gyisatshul/ bdag cag zhag ma lon par bcom ldan 'das la phyobalta ba'i phyir 74—147

'gro'o snyam mo/ /de nas sngon 6)ri dgas su gyur pa'i lha'i bu rna cha gdub kor (snyedag cing mgul rgyan (5)thogs pa/ lus do shal dang se mo dos brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras tsho4)pa'i cod (5)pan can lus gur gum (6)dang / ta ma la'i lo ma dang spro tsho )ka la sogs pas byug pa zhinadag gis de nyid kyi mtshan mo lha'i me tog ud (9)pa la dang / pad ma dang / ku timu da (nyadang / pad ma dkar po dang / man dā ra ba (snyernams kyis thu ba bkang ste/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad 'od chen pos snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la me tog gis gtor te42/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal teyi/chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan to.a/ /de dag gis chos thos nas bden pa mthong bar gyur te/ de dag gis tsobaden pa mthong nas rang gi gnas su dong ngo / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nyi thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur pa mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ mdang sum 9/)mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'am/lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che (7ba gzhan 'ga' tsho )zhig bcom ldan 'das la ( k+ṣebalta ba'i slad du mchis lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/dge slong dag mdang sum mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin nam/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'am lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba gzhan 'ga' zhu)zhig nga la blta zhugeba'i phyir 'ongs pa ma yin gyis(ste/ dge slong dag khyod 6gekyis nags khung dgon pa na/ ri dgas lnga brgya rngon pa rnams kyis 74—148

mda' 6)'phangs te bsad pa mthong ngam/ gsol pa/ btsun pa mthong lags so / /bka' stsal pa/ de dag nga la sems dga' bar gyur bzhin du shi 'phos nas dus las 'das pa las lha'i nang du skyes te/ lhar gyur nas nga'i thad du 'ongs te/ de dag la 5gengs chos bstan ri nas/ nga 54)las 5chos thos pa des na de dag gise yibaden pa rnams mthong ste bye/ de dag gis bden pa mthong nas/rang gi gnas su song (8)ngo / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa rngon pa de dag gis las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin ponyepas gdol pa'i rigs su skyes lags/ ri dgas de dag gis las ci bgyis na⑩/ las de'i rnam par smin 37pas ri dgas su skyes nas/ 'di rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis (rtelags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la 'di dag thams cad rab tu byung 1 ste/ dge slong 'thab grol can ④kha mi mkhas pa sha stag tu gyur te/ dge slong dag la dzo/—snyeder de rnams kyis gdol pa zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod do/ /kha cig gis 7dud 'gro zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod de' rme/ gang dag gis dud 'gro zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod pa de dag ni dud 'gror skyes so/ /gang dag gis gdol pa zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod pa de dag ni gdol par skyes so/ / de dag gis 18der tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/ dbang po rnams 37yongs su smin par byas pa des ni da ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //gong ma sreg ces bya ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das dge slong stong du )nyis zhu7brgya (rtelnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / tshong pa lnga brgya dang / sprang po 74—149

lnga brgya dang / thabs cig yo)tu ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/ nags khrod cig (0tu lam phyung ste / bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa'i ④ma/ nags khrod de'i nang gi gnas su ⑤me chen po 'bar nas/ des zhuskye bo phal po che dag 'jigs shing 7skrag par gyur te/ bdag cag ni tshig zin no/ /bdag cag ni 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i skabs med do snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che dag 'jigs shing skrag par dugazigs so/ /gzigs nas kyang 'gron po)po de ⑩rnams kyi mdun logs su gshegs yinas/ tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi stobs gang dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi stobs gang dang / /sangs rgyas dkon mchog gzi brjid kyis/ /me 7khyod lam ni dbye bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi stobs gang dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi stobs gang dang / /dam chos dkon mchog gzi brjid kyis/ /me tikhyod lam ni dbye bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi stobs gang dang / /dgra bcom rnams kyi stobs gang dang / /dge 'dun dkon mchog gzi brjid kyis/ /me 0khyod lam ni dbye bar gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces gsungs ma thag tu me 8zhi bar gyur nas/ tshong pa de dag bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan to/ /de nas ⑩de dag gi nang nas kha cig gis ni dro bar gyur pa bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni spyi tsobo dang / bden pa dang 'thun pa'i bzod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi ྅nyechos kyi mchog dang / mthong ba'i snyoms par 'jug pa bskyed do/ /kha cig gis ni rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas 74—150
