mi ma yin pa'i ①tshe spangs nas/ /rmongs pa med par mngal du 'jug /bdag ②gi yid ni sdom la dga'/ /man ngag gis ni phongs (7mi 'gyur/ /bstan pa'i lam la rten bcas shing / /tshangs par spyod la ligazhol bgyis nas/ /bsod snyoms ⑤rgyu ba spyad par bgyi/ /bdag ni 'os (7par gnas nas (7)kyang / /gal te bka' lung thob gyur na/ /bka' lung stsal ba bzhin du bgyi/ /de (nyanyid bdag gi sdug bsngal mtha'/ /gal te de ltar ma gyur nas/ /tshe yi (9)mtha' ni zad pa'i tshe/ /'og min lha ni gang yin pa/ /de dag tu ni skye bar shog /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni rgyun du zhugs pa lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag ni rgyun du zhugs pa lags so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong bar 'gyur ba'i re ba yang bdag la mchis lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka legs so legs 7so/ /de'i skal ba khyod la yod de(1/ de yang bag yod pas 'thob bo/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ gang gis bdag ni zhi 'gyur lakyi/ /rgyun du zhugs par nges 'byung ba/ /bcom ldan khyod las gzhan la 4)med/ /khyod kyi bstan las gzhan la med/ /khyad par rgya chen dang po'i rtagazhi/ /gzhan dag lta la ga la mchis/ /khyad par thob pa ci tsha'adra ba/ /sngon 7chad bogazhan las yong ma thob/ /btsun pa bdag tsho)ni 'di nyid na39/ /mchis shing lha (3 lus bgyid bzhin du/ /bdag gis tshe ring thob lags kyis(5/ /blo ldan de ltar gzung du gsol/ /chos kyi rnam ⑦grangs 'di bshad pa na/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha brgyad khri sa chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes te/ des bden pa mthong nas/ stan de kho na las shi 'phos nas/stan de kho na nyid la phyir skyes so/ /de ltar de shi 'phos pa dang / skyes pa ni 74—201

mig mi 6)'dzums ②pa dang / mi snang bar gyur pa dang ②/ lus kyi reg pa'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo bde sogs kyis kyang rtogs so/ /de nas lha ma yin gyi bu mo bde sogs kyis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la smras pa/ kau shi ka khyod shi 'phos nas/skyes lags sam/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ bde sogs nga 0shi 'phos nas phyir skyes te⑤/ 'di na 'dug bzhin du phyir bdag gi tshe duthob par gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya ④byin gyis bden pa mthong nas dga' zhing mgu la rab tu dga' zhing yi ⑧rangs te/ dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑨nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags ⑩lags 8so/ /'phags kyilags so/ /deng slan cad 8ji srid 'tsho'i byabar du dge bsnyen lags pa dang / khong nas dga' ste skyabs su mchis ⑩lags par gzung ⑩du gsol/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dri za'i bu gtsug phud lnga pa la smras pa/ bu khyod ni bdag la phan pa dang bde ba tsoyin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'gro bar yithog ma khyod kyis bskul to0/ /bu zur phud lnga pa bdag cag 'di nas sum cu 0rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i duyul du dong nas/ khyod kyis dusngon yun ring po nas 'dod cing smon pa gang yin pa'i dri za'i rgyal po dum bu ru'i ④bu mo bzang mo zhes bya ba 'od bzangs dude/ khyod kyi chung mar sbyin no/ /dri za rnams kyi dbang po khyod kyi pa'i rgyal sar yang tsogazhug go/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/sum cu 0rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la smras pa/ grogs po dag bdag gis sngon 74—202

cad ①mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa la/ dus gsum ②du tshangs pa la 'os pa'i 'dud pa byed pa gang yin pa de ni/ bdag gis da phyin cad ①bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid la tshangs pa la 'os pa'i 'dud pas ④'dud par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das 'di nyid tshangs pa yin/ tshangs par gyur pa yin/ zhi ba yin/ zhi bar gyur pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / lha gzhan rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/mdun gyis phyogs shing phyir nur nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'dud bzhin du/lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ⑤mig lam du mi snang bar gyur pa'i sa dunas/ bla gos phrag ⑦pa gcig tu gzar ①te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo phyag 'tshal lo 6)zhes smras nas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin ⑩de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to7/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur la/ 'dis bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis 7te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das ⑩lha brgyad khri bo 'di rnams kyis kyang las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas brgya byin 'di 0kho na las brten tsonas/'di rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' 7stsal pa/ smon lam gyi dbang 74—203

las gyur to/ /gsol pa 'di rnams kyis smon lam gang du btab lags/bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye dgu'i 6)tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i (9kha lo sgyur ②ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ④'khor ba 'jig ces bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste(5)/ des gang gi tshe bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes yinas/ /rgyal po'i pho brang mdzes ldan du gshegs pa de'i tshe/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi phyir rgyal po stimadzes pas/ gtsug lag khang lnga brgya brtsigs (kyete/ dzi)gnas khang drug stong byas nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phul te/gtsug lag khang de dag tu yo byad thams cad sbyar nas/ 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pas7/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba yi'ajig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la/ mchod pa'i las skol brtson par gyur to/ /de nas gang gi tshe yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin 4snyelas thams cad mdzad nas/ phung po yilhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su 7skya ngan las 'das pa de'i tsotshe/ rgyal po mdzes pas de'i sku gdung la mchod pa byas nas/ sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs 7te/rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byas nas/ mchod rten de la mchod pa chen po dzigebyas te/ smon lam btab pa khe/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba 3 tshode dang der 0gal te/ sulhar skye bar gyur 74—204

na ni/ lha che bar grags pa/ lha rnams kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur cig /gal te mir skye bar gyur na ni mi che bar grags pa 0)mi rnams kyi nang nas rin)rgyal srid kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur cig ces byas so/ /de nas rgyal pos 5smon lam 'debs pa zham 0ring ba rnams kyis mthong nas dris pa/ lhas (5)smon lam ci zhig btab lags / de nas des 6)de dag la rgyas par bsnyad nas/ de (7)thos ma thag tu de dag gis kyang mchod rten de la bkur ste 48byas nas/ smon lam btab pa/kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na5)/ bdag cag gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba ⑩de dang der phyug cing / nor mang la /nyalongs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye bar shog shig rgyal po 'di kho na la brten kyi nas/ bdag cag gis ston pa 'di lta bu mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig ces byas sol/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe rgyal po mdzes par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di kho na yin te/ des der tu yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur yibyas nas/ smon lam btab pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas/ ched 8'ga' lhar skyes pa'i tshe ni lha che bar grags par gyur te/ lha rnams kyi mnga' bdag byas so/ /ched 'ga' mir skyes pa'i tshe ni/ mi che bar grags par gyur nas/ mi rnams kyi 7rgyal srid kyi mnga' bdag byas te/ dge slong dag nga yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig dang shin tu mnyam pa dang / shugs mnyam pa dang / mdzad pa mnyam pa dang / thabs mnyam pa brnyes zhi par gyur nas/ 'dis nga mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par ma byas so/ /de'i tshe zham ring ba 18brgyad khrir gyur pa gang yin pa de dag 74—205

ni / lha brgyad khri bo 'di dag kho na yin te/ de dag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur 6)byas nas/ smon lam btab pa'i las de'i rnam par smin pas gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der/ phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skyes te/ brgya byin 'di kho na la ②brten nas 'di rnams kyis nga mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par ma byas so// //rgyal po zhes bya ba ni/ gleng ①gzhi dumanyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod pa na/ bram ze zhig gnas pa des/ thabs zlar bab pa las/chung ma blangs nas de de dang lhan cig tu 0rtse zhing dga' la rjodaga' mgur ⑦spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu ⑧lon pa na ①bu btsas nas de gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ yi ge dang bram ze'i spyod lam dang / spyod pa dang / oṃ zhes bya ba dang / bho zhes bya ba dang /gtsang sbra dang / cho ga dang thal ba blang ba dang / ril ba thogs pa dang /nges tibarjod kyi ⑨rig byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig byed dang / srid srung 8gi rig byed dang / mchod sbyin bya ba dang /mchod sbyin byed du gzhug ⑩pa dang / sbyin pa dang / blang ba dang / kha ton bya ba ④dang / kha ton slob tu gzhug pa'i thabs bslabs 8nas/ las rnam pa drug la mkhas pa'i bram zer gyur te/ de mthar gyis rig pa'i gnas bcwa ⑩brgyad la byang bar gyur to0/ /de nas phyi zhig na de'i 8pha ma gnyis shi'o/ /de gnyis shi nas khye'u ⑩des bsams pa/ bram ze rnams kyi lugs kyis nadu/ lo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/ de'i 'og tu chung ma 74—206

len par byed kyis①/ bdag gis kyang lo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad tshangs par spyod pa spyad par bya'o snyam nas/ des lo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas chung ma blangs te/ de'i chung ma gzugs bzang zhing blta ②na sdug la mdzes pa dang / g.yem zhing skyes pa 'dod pa zhig ste/ de khyim thab ①rgan po dang lhan cig du'adug pas snying mi tshim nas/ des skyes pa gzhan btsal to/ /de nas phyi zhig na de'i blo skyes pa/ bdag gis dhikhyim thab 'di 0ji srid 'di rgyan 'dug pa'i ⑧bar du ni/ bdag skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig 7nyal ba'i skabs med kyisakyi/ bdag gis 'di 7yul gzhan du gtang 8bar bya'o snyam nas/bram ze de la smras pa/ ji ⑩ltar jo bo'i 8khyim na ji ⑩yang mi bdog na/ khyod tsokyis ⑩bdag blangs 8te ci bgyi8/ bdag pha ma'i khyim du slar mchi'o/ /'on kyang dubadag gis 0'tshal ma bde blag duku 'tshal du mchis so/ /bram zes smras pa / bzang mo mi dga' bar tsom byed cig /④bdag cag bram ze rnams la slong dumos 'tsho ba yang yod kyisatso/ bdag yul gzhan du song la nor btsal te/phyir 'ong ngo zhes byas nas/ chung ma la brgyags phogs te ⑦song ngo / /de song nas kār ṣā ⑥pa ṇa mang po zhig rnyed nas de dag khyer te/ mnyan du yod par chas pa las/ de lam du mi rgod kyis bcom nas de ⑥shin tu sdug 0bsngal bar gyur te/ gal te bdag khyim du song zhun ni bram ze mo dang 'thab dumo chen po 'byung bar 'gyur gyis0/ bdag gis 'tsho ba 'di lta bu btang la/ nags khung thibs por song ste④/ bdag 'chi bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nags khung thibs por song ste/ shing ka dunas thag pas btags nas/ 'gag ⑩par byas pa las/ de'i skabs su bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ bram ze 'di nga'i 74—207

bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ba zhig na/ 6)'di lta bu'i gzu lums nasabyed cing 'dug go snyam du dgongs nas/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa nas mi snang bar gyur (8)te/ nags khung thibs po (45der gshegs nas(snye/bcom ldan 'das kyis bram ze 56)de la bka' stsal pa/ bram ze gzu lums 4)ma byed cigan /ngas khyod la nor sbyin tshono zhes bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la gter bstan te/ bram ze khyod kyi nor 'di yin gyi srog phangs ⑩pa ma dor cig ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das slar tshormigatsug lag khang du / gshegs so/ /de nas bram ze des nor de dag khyer te rang gi khyim du song nas / de nyu khyim gyi 'byor pa rgyas par byas te bzhag nas sbyin pa dag sbyin tso zhing bsod nams dag byed pa la zhugs so/ /de nas phyi zhig na de'i blo skyes pa/dge sbyong gau ta ma ni bdag la phan pa dang dben pa yin gyis/ bdag tshukhyim na gnas pa btang la/ de'i thad du rab tu 'byung tsobar bya'o snyam ste/ khyim gyi 'khor btang nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong 1 ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go/ /18bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i bsam pa dang / bag la nyal sna)dang /khams dang / shes pa dang / rang bzhin thugs 2 )su chud nas de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na 27bram ze des stan de nyid la 'dug bzhin du/'jig 2tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i nyertse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 2 rinas/ bcom ldan 74—208

'das ga la ba de 6)logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de na)/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ②ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das (4kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ste557/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de (5)la lung yang phog stiste/ des kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrub 8pa dang 'bad pas 6)nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid khomangon sum du byas so / /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas 1rtabacom ldan 'das la gsol pa/btsun pa bram ze 'di dbul bas 'jigs nas/ bdag nyid 'gum par bgyid tugepa las bcom ldan 'das kyis nor gyi phung po chen po dang sprad deyin/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa tshadang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod ⑫pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da ltar 'ba' zhig ma 8yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na 1 yang bram ze 'di dbul bas 'jigs nas/bdag nyid 'chi bar byas pa las/ ngas nor gyi phung po chen po 18byin nas/dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la ci ltar gnas par 19byas pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po dbang chen sde zhes sum̐ )bya ba rgyal po byed de de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang /bde ba dang / lo (7legs pa dang / skye bo dang mi mang pos gang ba dang /rtsod ( )pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang /chom rkun dang / nad dang / mu ge med pa dang / 'bras sā /lu dang / bu 74—209

ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher hu)ma dkrugs ②la/ bu gcig ①pa sdug pa la bya ba bzhin du chos bzhin du ④rgyal srid byed do/ /rgyal po de duyang byams pa'i bdag nyid can snying rje dang ldan pa/ sems can ⑥la byams pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba zhig ste/ de ⑦sbyin pa dag sbyin nizhing bsod nams dag byed del/ dge sbyong ⑩dang / bram ze dang / sdug cing phongs ⑩pa dang bkren pa rnams la ⑩ci dang ci 'dod pa sbyin par byed do8/ /bza' ba dang bca' ba mang po dag ④sta gon 8byas te/srog chags nam mkha' la tshuganas pa dang / chu na gnas pa dang / thang la gnas pa rnams la sbyin par byed do/ /'jig rten dag kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi tshulam la bkod 8par byed do/ / de nas phyin cad yibadag gis sems can rnams la thams cad sbyin no zhes dam bcas so/ /de nas duchos bzhin du rgyal po byed pas/ mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams kyis kyang de la bsrung ⑥ba dang /bskyab pa dang / sba ba'i phyir brtson par byed des/ de dag gis dus dus su char gyi rgyun legs par 'bebs shing 'bru rnams rgyas par dubyed do/ /rgyal po de'i 'dab ④kyi nyi 'og gi rgyal po ni/ chos ma yin pas rgyal po byed de/ shing sgrog tsodang / rkang sgril dang / lag sgril dang / an pan gdags ⑩pa rnams kyis / yul na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po la gnod pa 0byed de/ de'i mi rnams nan gyis dpya bla skyes rgyud byams 'jigs te/ rgyal po dbang chen sde'i yul du dong ste 'khod do/ /de nas phyi zhig na nyi 'og gi rgyal po de blon po mang pos zhabs 'bring byas nas/ yul bltar ⑥song song ba las/ des bltas na 0grong dang ske/ grong rdal dudang / gong khyer dudang / nags khrod kyi grong dang /74—210

tshong dus rnams stongs par ①mthong nas/ blon po rnams la kwa'i ci'i phyir yul stongs pa ②la thug par gyur ces dris nas ①blon po rnams na ④ri/ lha rgyal po dbang chen sde'i yul 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang ldan la/ skye bo mang po de dag kyang dpya khral ma mchis pa dang 'dra bar 'khod pas dun/ skye bo phal po che 0rnams der dong ste ⑦'khod do zhes zer ro/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu nyi 'og gi rgyal po de nikhros nas/dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi go bskon te/ rgyal po dbang chen sde dang g.yul ⑨'gyed pa'i phyir drangs so/ /de nas rgyal po dbang chen sde 0nyi 'og gi rgyal po de khros nas dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi go bskon 7te/ bdag dang g.yul 'gyed pa'i phyir drangs so zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang blon po 8rnams bsogs (nyete bsgo ba/ kye ngas ni tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba tsam gyi phyir sdig pa byed ④mi phod kyis8ske/ gal te khyod yiyul phung bar 'gyur ⑩mi 'dod na ni/ nyi 'og gi rgyal po de la phyag 'tshol 8cig /nga ni de la gnod pa byed mi phod do zhes byas nas/tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ nags kyi nang na shing shun shar bu'i yigos gyon cing ske/ /'bras bu za la gcan gzan ⑥ dag dang 'grogs kyang bla'i0/ /'jig rten pha rol dag gis 'dzem pa'i ⑤mi rnams kyis/ /rgyal srid dag gi phyir ni gsod dudang bcing mi bya/ /de nas blon po rnams kyis bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di ni su la yang gsod mi phod debu/ bdag cag kun med par gyur phyin mi rung gisatso/ bdag cag thams cad gyi na dul sdug bsngal bar gyur pa bas ni/bdag cag gis tso'adi gcig pu ⑥bor yang bla'o dusnyam nas de dag gis ⑥rgyal po bor tedu/ nyi 'og gi rgyal po de la babs duso/ /de nas rgyal po dbang chen 74—211

sdes kyang tshor te/ blon po 'di rnams kyis bdag bor ro snyam nas/ nags kyi 6)nang du gnas bcas te/ de der song nas rtsa ba dang 'bras bu za zhing 'dug go//de song ba'i 'og tu nyi 'og (migi rgyal po de 'ongs nas yul mi rnams phab ste /rgyal po de gar song zhes dris na/ blon po rnams na re lha bros lags so ④zhes zer ro/ /de nas nyi 'og gi rgyal pos g.yul de cham du phab ste/ dpa' bo thams cad kyi bya dgar bgo bsha' (gebyas nas/ yul de nyid du btab ste sti'adug go / /de nas de'i tshe ri khrod kyi grong zhig na/ bram ze dbul po 'tsho bas 79)phongs 2)pa zhig gnas te/ mthar gyis de'i bu dang bu mo mang po btsas phyananas / de gso ba mang la yul der mu ge yang byung nas/ de yikhyim gyi bza' 0mi rnams bskyang 15ma nus so/ /de nas bram ze des bā rā ṇa sī na 'argyal po dbang chen sde zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ rgyal po de yang byams pa'i bdag nyid can/snying rje dang ldan pa sems can la byams pa/ sbyin pa la dga' ba/ thams cad sbyin par byed pa zhig go zhes thos nas/ bdag 8de'i thad du 'gro bar bya'o / /de'i thad du song ba gedang bdag ni tsonor de las 'ong ngo yi 7snyam nas bā rā ṇa sīr 12song ngo / /de der song nas rgyal po dbang chen sdes 67nags su gnas bcas so zhes thos so/ /de so rathos ma thag tu bram ze de shin tu sdug bsngal bar gyur nas bsams pa/ bdag de'i thad du dka' (7thub kyi nags tshal du song ba dgedang / de de 3 na 'dug kyang bdag la nor sbyin ④par 'gyur ⑤yang srid do snyam nas/ sa phyogs gang na byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa der song ste / de'i thad du song nas byang chub sems dpa' des 69de la tshig 'jam pos ⑦mgu bar byas te/ rtsa ba dang 'bras bu dag byin nas dris pa/ khyod 'dir ci 74—212

la 'ong 6)/ bram zes smras pa/ da ltar mu ge byung ste/ phongs (mishing gnod par gyur la/ bdag la gso ba yang mang na/ bdag gis de dag gso yang ma nus nas/ bdag gis thos na (5)rgyal po dbang chen sde ni thams cad sbyin par byed do zhes thos nas/ de bdag gi (4༄nor gyi 'byung khung du (ge'agyur ro snyam ste/ khyod kyi ⑥thad du mchis so/ /byang chub sems dpa'as (7༄smras pa/ des nags kyi nang du gnas bcas so zhes khyod (8)kyis ma thos sam/ da de la nor ga la 6)yod / de nas de yithos ma thag tu bram ze de re 11thag chad nas brgyal te tsos la 'gyel 8to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'as de'i 7)gdong du chu tushegator te de ⑩bslang ngo / / de nas tshopho des bsams pa bdag la 'tsho ba 'di lta bu ci dgos kyis spre)bdag song la nags stug po'i nyukhenang du zhugs 3 7te/ 'chi bar bya'o snyam nas thag pa khyer te nags stug po'i nang du zhugs nas shing ka nas thag pas btags te 'gag 62par byas pa las/ byang chub sems dpa'as mthong ( 2nas / mthong ma thag tu snying rje skyes nas rte/ des bsams pa gal te bram ze 'dis bdag khrid de dgra'i thad du song na ni des 'di la rdo rinor gyi phung po sbyin (nyepar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ bram ze de la smras pa/ bram ze gzu lums (2nyam byed cig dang ⑥/ ngas khyod kyi phyodabul ba gcad ri par bya'o/ /bram ze khyod tshur shog /nga phyin blu )ka log tu dam por bcings zhu7la/ rgyal po che ge mo zhig gi thad du khrid de song shig dang / des khyod la nor gyi phung po chen po sbyin nunyepar 'gyur ro/ /bram zes smras pa/ bdag ni khyod lta bu 'chings ri mi phod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'as (༄smras pa/ the tsom 85med par gyis ninyal nga chings la du tshokhrid de song shig /de las thabs gud na ma mthong ngo / /de nas bram ze (nyan 74—213

re khyod ci ltar 'dod pa ①bzhin du bgyi'o zhes bgyis ②nas/ bram ze des byang chub sems dpa' phyin ②ka log tu ④bcings nas khrid de bā rā ṇa sīr ⑤chas so / /de nas de skye ⑥bo mang po de dag gis mthong nas ngo shes te/ de dag rgyal po'i thad du song ⑦sto gsol na/ de dag la rgyal po yid ma niches nas/ de gtad 6)bzhin du rgyal po'i pho brang nas phyung ste0/ byang chub sems dpa'i thad du song nas/ bram ze des/ byang chub sems dpa' dam du bcings te 0khrid de 'ongs pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang dris pa 'di khyod kyis tsog las khrid de 'ongs / des smras pa/ 'di ni lha'i dgra lags te/ 'di ni tibadag gis dka' 8thub kyi nags tshal na gnas pa las mthus bzung nas khrid de mchis so/ /de nas rgyal pos bsams pa/ rgyal po 'di ni lus che zhing stobs che la8/ bram ze 'di ni lus nyam 7chung bas na/ 'dis 'di ⑩gzung tsobar ga la nus te/'di ni yisnying rje che la sems can la byams pas na/ 'dis bdag gis bdag bcings nas/ 'di la byin gor ma chag 0snyam ste/ bram ze de la smras pa/⑥bram ze 'di khyod kyis ji ltar bzung 'ab drang por 3smros shig /de nas bram ze des rgyal po de la duji ltar gyur pa bzhin du bsnyad tsodo/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu rgyal po de dad par gyur nas sems can dag pa 'di lta bu la bdag gis gnod pa byas so snyam nas bdag nyid kyis bkrol te/ rgyal po'i pho brang du spyan drangs nas ⑩yan lag thams cad kyis 'khyud ⑦de/ seng ge'i khri'i steng du bzhag phyinas/ cod pan gyi thabs bud ⑥de/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbu la btags nas smras pa/ khyod ni rgyal po'i 'os lags kyi/ bdag ni 'os ma ⑥lags so zhes byas nas/ des de la dpung gi tshogs dang / dkor mdzod 74—214

rnams phul nas bzod pa ①gsol te rang gi yul du song ngo / /de nas rgyal po dbang chen ②sdos/ bram ze de la nor gyi phung po chen po byin ①nas/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas par byas so/ /dge slong dag de'i tshe rgyal po dbang chen sder gyur pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe bram zer gyur dupa gang yin pa de ni/ bram ze 'di kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang 'di dudabul bas 'jigs pas/ bdag nyid 'chi bar byas pa las/ ngas nor gyi phung po chen po yibyin nas/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gnas par byas so/ /da ⑦ltar yang 'di dbul bas ni'ajigs pas/bdag nyid 'chi bar byas pa las/ ngas nor gyi phung po chen po byin nas/g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod do0// //rngon pa zhes bya ba ⑩ni/ bcom ldan 'das yul cha/ ga ṅgār 7ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/ 8rgyal po'i khab tu byon nas rgyal po'i 8khab kyi 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa na bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe lhas ④byin ni rgyal po'i khab na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po la rtag tu nyes pa byed de 8gang dang gang la nyes pa byed ⑩pa de dang de⑩/ bcom ldan 'das la nyes pas sting 8bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/kun dga' bo yisong la chos gos snam 0sbyar gyon te/ dge slong su yang rung ba zhig grogs su khrid la/ rgyal po'i khab tu lam po che dang 0srang dang / bzhi mdo dudang sum mdo dudag tu bram 0ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la lhas byin nam / lhas byin dugyi phyogs kyis ⑥su la ⑥nyes pa phyibyas pa des ⑥sangs rgyas sam 74—215

chos sam dge 'dun la 0)'dog (gepar ma byed cig ces sgos gshig /gal te lhas byin cani rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin no zhes zer na/ sngon (geni rdzu 'phrul che na da ni de'i rdzu 'phrul nyams so/ /zhes gyis shig ces bka' stsal to6) / /de nas kun dga' bo song ste/ rgyal po'i khab tu lam po che dang /srang dang / bzhi mdo (7dang / sum mdo (8)dag tu bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams la bsgo (9)nas/ phyin cad ⑩bcom ldan 'das la nyes pas snying yibar mi byed do/ /de nas phyi zhig na bcom ldan 'das bsnyung (gebar gyur nasahurte/ sman pa 'tsho byed kyis bcom ldan 'das la sman mar lcags mda' zhes bya ba phul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed la bka' stsal pa/'tsho byed ngo mtshar che'am/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar 0che lags so//bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed rmad du byung gengam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rmad du byung chulags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed khyod tu shes sam/ gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das bdag 'tshal nyushelags so/ bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed khyod mi shes sam/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das bdag ma 'tshal lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed ci zhig ngo mtshar che/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das pa rmo kyirnams rtswa )za zhing chu 'thung ( skyel/ de dag las bdud rtsi 'di grub 9 shecing / des sman mar lcags mda' zhes bgyi sonyeb bsgral lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed ci zhig rmad du byung / gsol pa bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba las/ dam pa'i chos bstan pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bsgrub 26pa bzang po 'byung snelags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed khyod ci zhig shes/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das skyes slan cad sa gdon mi 'tshal bar 74—216

'dug na ngas (1)nyin gcig (wabazhin du ri dgas bzang ngo cog chabasad de/ sha ji snyed dgos pa de snyed sbyin geno zhes smras nas/ ri dgas kyi rgyal po seng ge song ste/ des nyin gcig (snyebazhin du ri dgas bzang ngo cog bsad nas/ mi rjode la sha mang po sbyin 4)no/ /de nas phyi zhig na rngon pa des sha khur gyis bskyal ⑧te / rang gi khyim du 'gro ba na/ de bya 1)khra des mthong nas ngo shes te/ ⑩khya des rngon pa de 47la smras pa/ grogs po khyod dka' bas 'tsho ba 'di lta bu zhig gis 'tsho zhing 'dug gam/ rngon pas smras pa/ bdag cag 8gi 'tsho ba ni 'di yin te/ thabs 'dis bdag 'tsho ba tshol tu)lo/ /de nas khra des bsams pa/mi 'dis sngon bdag gi srog phyung bas min/ 'di la bdag gis drin lan bsab dgos so snyam nas/ des smras pa/ grogs po khyod 'dir 'dug shig dang bdag gis khyod kyi 8dbul ba gcad yipar bya'o zhes byas nas song ngo / /de nas khra des nyu tshorgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du song nas/ bdag gi 'dir yici zhig rnyed par gyur cig hu)gu bdag gis kyis )de khyer nas mi de la sbyin par bya'o snyam ste/steng gi nam mkha' la lding bzhin 7du bltas na/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i 'pho brang de na rgyal po dbang chen sde'i btsun mo dam pas rgyan thams cad bkrol nas gab tse'i ri rinang du bzhag ste/ skra bkrus pa )las khras rgyan rin rnams khyer nas mi de la byin te/ des 39khyer te rang gi khyim du chas pa las/ ri nami des mthong nas ngo shes te dris pa grogs po khyod kyis 'di ga las rnyed/ rngon pas de la smras pa4nya/khras bdag la byin no zhes smras ( rtenas/ rngon pa de bdag zhu )gi khyim du song ngo / /de nas rgyal po dbang chen sdes/ bya ba thams cad la bsgo ba/ khyod deng nunyal bya tshang thams cad du song ste/ rgyan nade dag khyer te shog shig ces byas so/ /74—224

mi snga ma des kyang tshor nas bsams pa/ 'dis bdag la (1)lan gnyis khron par lhung ba las phyung na ②mi rung gis(kyi/ bdag rgyal po'i thad du song la gsol bar bya'o / /'on kyang des ④bdag la bya dga' sbyin (gepar 'gyur ro snyam nas/ mi de song ste ⑥rgyal po la gsol pa/ rngon pa che ge mo zhig gis lha'i rgyan rnams khyer ro zhes byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu de la bya dga' chen po byin no/ /de nas rngon pa de bkug ste/ rgyan rnams kyang phrogs (nyanas khri mon du 98)bcug go/ /de 6)khri mon pho )na 'dug pa na (1byi ba des mthong nas 3 ngo shes te des bsams pa/mi gang gis bdag 8gi srog phyung ba de ni 'di yin gyis / 'di la bdag gis drin lan bsab par bya'o snyam nas/ des smras pa/ grogs po khyod ci nyes te khri mon 'dir tshubacug /de nas des de la rgyas par thams cad bsnyad 7do/ /de nas byi ba des smras pa/ grogs po khyod brtan por 1 tshomadzod la/ spro ba chen po bskyed ⑩cig dang / ngas khyod 'di na tut+ta'adug pa'i tshe/ zas dang skom 9 )gyis mdo 6)mi gzung nu)bar bya'o zhes byas nas ri/ byi ba des mi de 6 )khri mon na 'dug pa de la zas dang du ge/ skom gyis mdo (6mi gzung 2 bar byas so she/ /de nas phyi zhig na mi de khri mon na 'dug bzhin du/ sprul gdug pa des srog gcig ⑥tu byas te/ 'di la ngas ri )drin lan glan par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ mi de la smras pa/ kye mi 0khyod ngas (nyekhri mon 'di nas thar bar byas te/ dbang phyug gi bdag po chen po ( la gzhag du ripar bya'o zhes byas nas/ ngas (gergyal po 'di dug gis zin par byas la/ de bdag gi dug 69gis ci bya ra phogatol 8nyemed par gyur pa dang ⑥/ de'i tshe khyod ( )khri mon lhan 'dug pas/ rgyal po 'di (gegazhan sus kyang sos par byed mi nus te/ nga 'ba' zhig gis gso 4snyenas so zhes gyis sgo )74—225

shig /de nas rgyal po des khyod dgug ①pa dang / khyod der song la ba lang gi ②lci bas dkyil 'khor gyis lani/ me sbar te sngags 'di dubazlas brjod kyis shig dang ske/ khyod kyi sgra thos pas nga 'ong gis 0khyod kyis nga 'ongs pa dang rjo/ 'di skad du/ yang na mer mchongs shig /yang na rgyal po'i ⑦dug med par gyis shig ces byos ⑧shig dang / ngas 7khyod la 'di skad du ⑩bdag ni me'i nang du mchongs ⑩par bya'i8/ rgyal po'i dug ni med par mi bya'o zhes bya'o/ /de nas khyod kyis tsong la 'di 8skad du khyod kyis ⑫ srog bor du zin kyang / ngas kyang rgyal po'i 8srog mi gtong gi/ khyod kyis ⑩rgyal po 'di'i 'dug med par mi byar mi rung ngo yigyis shig dang / ngas khyod kyi tshig gis rgyal po'i dug med ⑥par bya'o / /'on tang 0de'i tshe rgyal po khyod la mnyes par gyur nas/ khri mon nas btang ste/ nor gyi phung po chen po sbyin par 'gyur ro duzhes byas nas/ sbrul gdug pa de kyisong ste rgyal po de dug gis zin nas/ rgyal po de ci bya gtol tsomed par gyur nas/ rngon pa des btson srungs byarnams la smras pa/ rgyal po 'di sus kyang dug med par tsomi nus te/ ngas 'di'i dug med par bya'o 0zhes byas so/ /de nas btson srungs tsornams kyis rgyal po la gsol to/ /de nas rgyal pos mi de ⑥bkug ste 0smras pa/ kye gal te mi khyod kyis nga'i srog gi skyabs byed nus par gyur na/ ngas khyod la nor gyi phung po chen po sbyin no zhes byas so/ /de nas mi des smras pa/ lha brtan por mdzod la spro ba chen po bskyed 0cig dang /bdag mchis bzhin du khyod grongs par dumi 'gyur ro zhes byas nas/ mi des ba lang gi lci bas dudakyil 'khor byas nas/ me sbar te sngags ⑥brjod do/ /de nas de thos nas sbrul gdug pa de dkyil 'khor gyi drung du 'ongs te bya'adug go/ /74—226

de nas mi des smras pa/ khyod ni ①'di na ②'dug pa ⑧don gnyis shig bya dgos te / yang na ni rgyal po'i ④dug med par gyis shig /yang na ni me'i nang du mchongs shig ces byas so/ /de nas sbrul gdug pas smras pa/ bdag ni 'di na 'dug pa ⑤don gnyis bya dgos pa lasaX/ yang na bdag nyid gtang ⑦bar bya dgos so/ /yang dun rgyal po bsad ⑨dgos so zhes byas tshunas/ sbrul gdug 0pa de mngon du phyogs shing 'dug pa las/ mi des bzlog ste ⑩smras pa/khyod kyis srog bor du zin kyang ngas rgyal po'i srog mi gtang gisatso/ khyod kyis rgyal po 'di'i dug med par mi byar mi rung ngo zhes byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu sbrul gdug pa des rgyal po'i dug med par byas so/ / de nas 8rgyal po mnyes par gyur nas/ rngon pa de tsonor gyi phung po ⑩byin te btang ngo / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe rngon par gyur ⑩pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa 8de ni nga 7nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe mi'i ⑩rgyal po la gsol ba gang yin pa de ni lha sbyin 0'di kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang 'di drin du dumi gzo ba dang / byas pa mi tshor ba dang / byas pa chud gson dupar gyur to// // las brgya tham pa/④ bam po sum cu tsolnga pa/ rmongs ⑩pa zhes bya ba ni0/gleng gzhi dumanyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe yul shur ⑥pa ra ka na khyim bdag cig duganas pa des/ thabs zlar bab pa las 0chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig 9tu 9rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de byazla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang / khye'u gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston 74—227

rgyas par byas nas/ ming rmongs tu)pa zhes btags so/ /de nas khye'u rmongs pa 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus bskyed (mibasrings te/ de gang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ yi ge dang / khong rtsis ( nadang / shod dgod pa dang / lag rtsis dang / dbyung ④ba dang / sba ba dang /ri dgram pa dang / gos brtag ⑥pa dang / nor bu brtag ⑦pa dang /rin po che brtag 9kyepa dang / spos brtag ⑨pa dang / sman brtag ⑩pa dang /glang po che brtag 17pa dang / rta brtag 8pa dang / go mtshon brtag pa bslabs ⑫te / yi ge mkhas pa dang / klog mkhas pa dang / mdzangs ④pa dang / bya ba la gsal ba dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / brtag 8pa rnam pa brgyad la byang bar gyur to/ /de nas phyi yizhig na de'i lus shur bu tu 7yungs 'bru tsam sha stag gis khyab par gyur te/ shur bu de dag kyang smin te rdol nas/ de'i lus rmas ⑫zhu lub tu g.yogs tsho//par gyur to/ /de nas (pe de'i phas sman pa thams cad las meyo byad ( rtesbyar te gsos kyang / de busos par byed ma nus nas/ de ci tsam du tshab che bar rko stegyur pa de tsam du/ lus las sogernag 'khrag 'dzag ste0/ dri nga ( — rib byung 2mngo / /de nas de'i lus thams cad spos chu du )sna tshogs kyis byugs te gos kyis g.yogs nas gso sonyabar byed do/ /de nas de'i phu nu rnams kyis mthong nas ming spos du te/ khye'u 'di'i lus gos dang / rgyan rnams kyis g.yogs te gsos 3pas na/ 'di'i dunaming sbas pa zhes bya'o zhes zer ro/ /de nas de la la las ni rmongs pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /smil las ni sbas pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /de nucanas phyi zhig na de'i pha ma gnyis shi'o/ /pha ma gnyis shi nas las su bya ba thams cad khye'u des (nyetshis dubyed de⑥/ de las gang byed kyang 74—228

rung —/ zhing blas ①byed kyang rung / tshong byed kyang rung / gru'i las byed kyang rung ske/ de ②las byas so cog (she'ajig cing 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas khyim bdag rmongs pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis 'dir las ④gang byed kyang rung ste/ zhing blas ⑤byed kyang rung / tshong byed kyang rung / gru'i las byed kyang rung / bdag gi ⑥las byas so cog 9)'jig cing 'grub (kyepar mi 'gyur na/ 'jig rten na mi 'jig pa'i chos gang 'jig par mi 'gyur ba 'ga' lta yod dam zhig ①gu snyam mo/ /7de nas khyim bdag rmongs 11pa de'i mdza' bo dang ske/ grogs po dang phu nu dang / rgan rabs rnying 7gi sngon gyi tu lha zhig khyim bdag rmongs pa'i khyim gyi sgo ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ khyim de thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas te/ khyim bdag rmongs pa la 'di skad ces smras so/ /khyim bdag khyod kyis 'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos can gang yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can ma yin pa gang yin pa mi shes sam/ khyim bdag gis smras pa/ lha bdag gis ni 'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos can gang yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can ma yin pa gang yin pa mi shes na/ lha khyod kyis 8'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos 8gang yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can ma yin pa gang yin pa shes sam/ lhas smras pa/ khyim bdag ngas 7kyang 'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos can gang yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can ma yin pa gang yin pa mi shes so/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ lha 'o na 'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos can gang 7yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can (3ma yin pa gang yin pa spyisus shes/ lhas smras pa( kye/ khyim bdag shes pa yod de/ dge sbyong gi ta ma 0shākya'i bu/ shākya'i rigs las skra 8nyadang kha (nyespu bregs te/ chos 74—229

gos tshon can rnams ①bgos nas/ yang dag pa'i dad pas khyim nas lakhyim med par rab tu byung nas/ des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ②mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ bcom ldan 'das des ni 'jig rten na 'jig pa'i chos can gang yin pa dang / 'jig pa'i chos can ma yin pa gang yin pa mkhyen toX/ /khyim bdag gis smras pa/ lha bcom ldan 'das de da ltar dug la bzhugs/ lhas smras pa/ khyim bdag shar phyogs kyi ljongs na/ yul mnyan du yod pa zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de'i nang na durgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin ⑦gyi kun dga' ra ba na/ da ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhugs kyisani/ khyim bdag khyod 'dod na/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song la der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la don 'di dris ⑨la / bcom ldan 'das des 0khyod la ji 0skad du lung bstan pa de bzhin du zung ⑫shig ces smras nas/ lha de 8de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu khyim bdag rmongs pa bcom ldan 'das la blta 8'dod par gyur to/ /de nas phyi zhig na yul shur par ku'i 4)tshong pa mang po de dag 4)zong khyer te/mnyan du yod par dong nas/ de dag der dong bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa rnyed par gyur te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs nas/ de dag phyi zhig na zong dang rin rnams khyer te yul shur pa ra kur 'ongs nas0/ de dag gis khyim bdag rmongs pa'i mdun du/ sangs rgyas dang chos kyi bsngags pa 8brjod do/ /'di skad ces kyang smras te/ bcom ldan 'das de ni thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa 8yin gyi/ de blta ⑥ba'i phyir khyod song shig dang / des khyod kyi 0lus dang sems kyi nad gso 74—230

bar ①'gyur ro/ /de nas des tshig de thos nas lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du bltar ②'gro ba'i spro ba skyes so/ /de nas phyi zhig na khyim bdag rmongs pas rgyags nimang po khyer te/ bzhon ④pa bzang po la zhon nas yul ①shur pa ra ⑦ ku'i sa ⑦nas ⑧bar zhag gis mnyan du yod par ④phyin te/ de ji srid du bzhon ⑩du rung ba'i sa ⑩de srid du bzhin 8pas song nas/ bzhon ⑩pa las babs te④/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste 8phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go⑩/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ khyim bdag rmongs pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni rnag can gyi lus 'di dman ⑩par gyur pa8/ ngo tsha bar gyur pas na spang bar ⑩'tshal lo/ /smad 0par 'tshal lo//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyim bdag lus 'di ni nad lta bu yin no / /phol mig lta bu yin no/ /zug rngu lta bu yin no zhes bka' stsal te/bcom ldan 'das kyis phung po 'di 0nyid las brtsams nas/ de la de dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na dhikhyim bdag rmongs pas stan 0de nyid la 'dug bzhin dubya/ 'jig 'tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po ④nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ des bden pa mthong nas bsams pa/zhu gal te bdag gi lus 'di kho na lta bur tsom gyur na/ bdag kyang legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ⑥ste/ chu bo rnams las 0yang dag par brgal 0bar bya ba dang / sbyor ba rnams las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir/ brtson pa dang / bsgrub ⑫pa dang / 'bad par bya ba zhig gu dusnyam mo/ /de ltar rab tu 'byung chaba'i 74—231

sems bskyed ma thag tu khyim bdag de'i lus lag mthil bzhin du rma med par gyur to/ /de nas de lhag par yang bcom ldan 'das la dga' bar gyur to/ / de nas 6)de 90dga' bar gyur nas stan las langs te/ bla ①gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar 4)nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de (9logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung stib dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi ⑦thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑧dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung 6)ste7/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas de la lung yang phog ste/ des kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrub tunyepa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas8/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ de dgra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser tu)dang bong bar 8mnyam pa'/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil yidu 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nye nga'i sbubs bcom pa/ rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so tu yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang /chags pa dang / bkur sti 67la mi lta bso )/ dbang po dang nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to//de nas tshe dang ldan pa rmongs pa snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gyon te/ lhung bzed (1thogs nas mnyan dgedu yod par tsobasod snyoms la song ba las/ ba drus mas brdungs te bsad nas/ de 'chi kur budabang po rnams rnam par dang 74—232

zhing ske/ bzhin gyi ①mdog yongs su dag pa la pags ②pa'i mdog dkar por ③gyur to/ /de nas dge slong mang po snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gyon te/lhung bzed duthogs nas mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la dong ba las dge slong mang po mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la dong ba rnams kyis yul shur pa ra ⑤ma'i khyim bdag rmongs pa zhes bya ba (nyagang yin pa de/ ba drus mas brdungs te bsad nas de ⑦'chi kur ⑧dbang po rnams rnam par dang zhing yo)bzhin gyi mdog yongs 0su dag ste/ pags hunyapa'i mdog dkar bar gyur to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang dge slong mang po rnams mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms blangs te/zan zos nas zas phyis len pa spangs nas4)/ lhung bzed dang chos gos bzhag ⑫nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song yiste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ dge slong mang po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa 'di 8na bdag cag ⑩dge slong mang po snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos 'tshal te/ lhung bzed thogs nas mnyan du 'o)yod par bsod snyoms la mchis pa las/ yul shur pa ra ku'i khyim bdag rmongs pa zhes bgyi ba ⑫de / ba drus mas brdungs yo)te bkum nas/ de 'gum kur hūṃ )dbang po rnams rnam par dang zhing 0bzhin gyi mdog yongs su dag ste/ pags (nyepa'i mdog dkar bar gyur to zhes thos lags na/ de'i 'gro ba ni gang lags/ de'i skye gnas ni gang lags/ 'gro ba'i sa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag rigs kyi bu de ni nga'i chos kyi rjes su 'thun pa'i chos rtogs pas na nor ṭo snyedu gyur pa yin no/ /dge slong dag rigs kyi bu de 74—233

mya ngan las 'das kyis①/ 'di'i rus bu la ②nas bu'i mchod pa gyis shig /de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa rmongs pa mchog tu gyur par lung bstan nas/ dge slong mang po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa bzhin du mnyan ①te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas dong nasadu/ de dag gis dude'i rus bu la yinas bu'i mchod pa byas te/ rus bu'i mchod rten brtsigs nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa metshe dang ldan pa rmongs ⑧pas las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas/ ba drus mas brdungs te bkum ⑨lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag 'di nyid kyis las de lta bu byas shing bsags pa'i steng du lhag par yang nga'i 0smon lam las gyur te/ puska ra'i 0sngon gyi rgyud las byung 8ba bzhin du rgyas par brjod par bya'o/ /gsol pa/ btsun pa tshe dang ldan pa 0rmongs pas las ci bgyis na/ las de'i rnam par smin pas phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su bskyes lags/ las ci bgyis na las de'i rnam par smin pas lus rma'i tho)zhu lub (9tu yog par gyur te/'di'i lus las ⑩rnag khrag 'dzag cing 'di'i lus las 8dri nga ba 'byung bar 'gyur ⑩la/ 'dis kyibacom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 0bstan pa la rab tu byung stedu/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nasaphyo/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis te/rab tu byung ④ba'i sems bskyed ma thag tu/ de'i lus la byarma ma mchis par gyur lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag da ltar tso'aba' 74—234

zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang 'dis las de ①dag byas shing bsags pas na/ 'di nyid kyis las byas shing bsags pa de dag gzhan su zhig gis nyams su myong bar 'gyur ②te/ dge slong dag las byas shing bsags pa rnams ni / phyi rol gyi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ chu'i khams dang /me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur te/ las dge ba dang / mi dge ba ②byas shing bsags pa rnams ni zin pa'i phung po dang /khams dang skye mched rnams 'ba' zhig la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /lus can dag gi dulas rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi za/ /tshogs shing dus la bab pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par du'agyur/ /dge slong dag dusngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs pas byin zhes bya ba zhig rgyal po byed de①/ de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī na khyim bdag gnyis shig gnas pa las de gnyis phan tshun 'gras nas/ de'i nang nas gcig gis rgyal po la nor mang po zhig phul te/ khyim bdag cig lashos rgyal po la khyabarnyas nas de rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyis shags 'gyed pa'i tshe g.yo shags ⑩kyis pham par byas nas khyim bdag de la byin te/ des de ⑩rang gi khyim du khrid nas lcag gis ⑫zhen par gzhus nas/ lcag tsomo de dag gi nang du dug gi phye mas gtor ④te/de'i lus de sha snag bu 8bzhin du gyur nas/ de phu nu rnams kyis nor mang po zhig gis blus 0te/ sman pa'i lung gis de'i lus sos par byas so/ /de nas phyi zhig na de skyo ba skyes nas bdag khyim na gnas pas 0chog gis8/ dka' thub kyi yinags tshal du 'gro'o snyam stedu/ sbyin bdag ⑥ sbyin zhing 'basod nams dag byas nas/ dka' duthub kyi nags tshal du rten bcas so/ /de der song 74—235

nas slob dpon med pa dang / man ngag med par byang chub kyi phyogs kyi ①chos sum cu (snyem bdun dran par byas nas/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas des bsams pa/ khyim bdag des ③bdag gi 0rgyud las ⑤bsod nams ma yin pa chen po bskyed kyis(nya/ bdag song la khyim bdag de'i ra ⑦mda' bya'o snyam nas/ gnas de nyid nas nam mkha' las (nyakhyim bdag de ga la ba der song nas/ 'bar ba dang / lam mer 'dug pa dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog 6)'gyu ba'i cho 'phrul rnams bstan to/ /so so'i skye bo ni rdzu 'phrul gyis myur du dad par 'gyur 7te/ de sdong po sog les skyebacad pa bzhin du de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ smras pa/ skal ba chen po tsomar spyon/ bdag nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying tu)ba las lag nas drang du gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas de kho na la snying brtse ba'i phyir sa la babs tshunas/ des de'i rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ bzod pa gsol nas smras pa/ 'phags pa khyod kyang bsod snyoms ⑫bzhed la/ bdag kyang bsod nams 'tshal bas/ bdag gi skyed mos tshal ⑩'di nyid du bzhugs shig dang / bdag gis yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur tsho bgyi'o/ /de nas rang sangs rgyas des khyim bdag de la cang mi smra tsobs gnang ngo / /de nas khyim bdag des nyu)rang (3 sangs rgyas de'i phyir yal ga dang lo ma'i spyil po phub (glenas/ yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed pa la zhugs so/ /de nas phyi zhu )zhig na rang sangs rgyas des bsams pa/ bdag gis rnag can gyi lus 'dis bya ba gang yin pa de ni bdag gis byas zin gyis tshu/ ma la bdag zhi ba'i dbyings su 'jug par bya'o snyam nas/ 'bar ba dang / lam mer 'dug pa dang / char 'bab pa dang / glog 'gyu lu )ba'i cho 'phrul rnams 74—236

bstan nas/ phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su ①mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas khyim bdag des de'i (7sku gdung la mchod pa byas nas/ sku gdung gi mchod rten brtsigs (bte/ mchod rten ④de la bkur sti lachen po byas nas/ smon lam btab pa/ kye ma dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis na dubadag gang dang gang du skye bar 'gyur ba 6)de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs su skye bar shog shig /'di bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i ston pa mnyes (8)par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /yon tan 'di lta bu dag kyang bdag gis thob par shog shig /bdag gis 'di la gnod par 5)byas pa'i las de bdag la 'ong bar ma gyur cig /ci ste las 'di'i rnam par smin pa bdag la gdon mi za bar 'ong bar gyur yin yang / rab tu byung (1ba'i sems bskyed ma thag tu/ bdag gi bkra mi shis pa de 8med par gyur te/ bkra shis pa 'byung bar gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong tunyedag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe khyim bdag tu gyur pa gang yin pa de ni tsorbongs pa 'di kho na yin te/ des khyim bdag de'i lus la lcag gis gzhus 8nas/ dug gi phye mas gtor ba'i las de'i rnam par smin pas ni gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der lus 'di lta 7bur gyur to/ /des phyir yang rang sangs rgyas de la bkur sti 3 byas nas/ smon lam btab pa'i las de'i rnam par tu)smin pas ni gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der phyug cing nor mang la longs spyod che ba'i rigs /)su skyes te/ dge slong dag nga 6 byerang sangs rgyas bye ba phrag sonya'abum ()bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa nga lta bu 'dis 'umanyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par 2stem byas la pa/ rab tu 'byung 85ba'i sems 74—237

bskyed ma thag tu de'i bkra mi shis pa med par gyur nasal/ bkra shis pa byung ②bar gyur te/ nga nyid kyi bstan pa la ①rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid ④mngon sum du ⑤byas so/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas du'od srung ⑦gi gsung ⑧rab la 'di rab tu byung ste/ der 'dis tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad ⑨nas dbang po rnams yongs su smin par byas ⑩pa des na da ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //bram ze gsum ⑩zhes bya ba de la/ bram ze dang po ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan 8du yod pa na bram ze zhig gis mchod sbyin bya bar brtsams te/ mchod sbyin byed pa der rgyal khams tha dad pa'i bram ze rnams 'dus par gyur te/ de dag gis bsams pa/ tsomachod sbyin byed pa gang du 'thab tsomo dang / mtshang 'dru tsob dang / 'gyed pa dang / rtsod ⑩pa 'byung ba'i mchod sbyin de ni mi 'grub bo snyam mo/ /de nas phyi zhig na mchod sbyin byed pa der ljongs na gnas pa'i bram ze dang / mthil ⑩na gnas pa'i bram ze yon gyi phyir 'dus 4)pa rnams 'thab tukyemo byung nas/ mthil dun gnas pa'i bram ze rnams kyis smras pa/ khyed ni zhing blas 0kyis 'tsho ba tshol ba ()yin pas na/yon 'di rnams ni khyod tshul 'os pa ma yin no/ /nged ni yon chaganas yin pas na / yon 'di rnams ni nged la 'os so zhes zer ro/ /ljongs na gnas pa rnams na re/ kye khyod ( nyernams kyang rgyal po'i dpa' bo la bsten ⑩pa yin pas na/khyod ⑦ni yon gyi gnas tsom yin gyi (7nged ni yon gnas yin pas0 / yon gyi 'os yin no zhes zer nas/ de dag der 'thab zhumo dang / mtshang 'dru dub dang ske/ 'gyed pa dang / rtsod pas g.yem 0spyo zhing 'khod pa'i skabs su/74—238

bram ze gzhan zhig gis 6)mchod sbyin byed ②pa'i gnas de nas gser dang ①/dngul dang / bza' ba dang / bca' ba mang po khyer te bros pa las de bram ze de ④dag gis bzung nas khu tshur dang / rdog pa dag gis shin tu zhen par brdegs te bor ro/ /de nas de brdegs btsogs (snyepas 'chi bas 'jigs shing skrag nas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du zhugs ⑥so/ /de der zhugs nas/sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun spyod lam mdzes shing sgra bskyungs te / ca co med par 'khod pa mthong ngo / /mthong ma thag tu de bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dga' bar gyur to/ /de dga' bar gyur nas bsams pa/bdag bram ze byed pas chog gisaphya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nibar bya'o snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste ①phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ⑩nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung ⑩ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs ⑫shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob 8tu rung na/ bdag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par spyod pa spyad 8par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de la byadage slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ⑩stetu)/ bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad nas de la lung yang phog ste/ des kyang brtson pa dang /bsgrub 8pa dang / 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ des dgra bcom pa nyid thob nas bsams pa / bdag gis gdul bar bya ba 'ga' lta ci yod snyam ste/ des bltas yin 74—239

mchod sbyin gyi bdag po la sogs pa/ bram ze stong phrag mang po 'dul bar 'gyur ba mthong nas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te/gnas de nyid nas nam mkha' la 6)mchod sbyin gyi (miganas der song nas mchod sbyin gyi bdag po dang / bram ze gzhan de sridag gis dge slong de steng gi nam mkha' las 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag dge slong de la ④shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas de rnams kyis pang gis 'khyud (9de stan la bzhag nas/ rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir mdun du 6ste'akhod do/ /de nas dge slong des de dag la de ⑦dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te / des na (gumachod sbyin gyi bdag po dang / bram ze de dag gis stan de dag kyisanyid la 'khod bzhin du 'jig 7tshogs (nyal lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas so/ /'khor de dag gi 3)nang nas phal cher ni sangs rgyas la gzhol ba dang / chos la 'bab pa dang / dge 'dun la bab 0)par byas te bkod do/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ btsun pa bram ze 'dis las ci bgyis nayi/ las de'i rnam par smin pas 'dis bcom ldan 'das mnyes par bgyis te⑩/ mi mnyes par ma bgyis la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 9bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa 4 thams cad spangs te/dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du bgyis lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smon lam gyi 4snyedabang las gyur to/ /gsol pa/ 'dis smon lam gang du btab lags4)/( ) dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i 0dus na/bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la skye ()dgu'i tshe lo nyi khri thub pa na/ yang dag par 74—240

rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i 6)kha lo sgyur (5)ba/ bla na med pa/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od srung zhi)zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī na bram ze zhig gnas pa las/gtan tshigs snga ma bzhin du gyur te/ rab tu byung nas des der gi)tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas 'chi kur ( smon lam btab (6)pa/ 'di ltar bdag gis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od sung gi bstan pa la/ tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad kyang / yon tan gyi tshogs ci yang ma thob kyi 6)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon 6)sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas so/ /dge slong dag ji (7)snyam du sems/de'i tshe bram zer gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ bram ze 'di kho na yin te/ des der tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad yinas/ 'chi kur (1smon lam btab stetshul/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gis bram ze'i 'khye'u bla ma lung bstan pa gang yin pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de bdag gis mnyes par byed par gyur cig /mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig /de kho na'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byed par gyur cig ces byas pa des na/ dge slong dag nga yang dag par 'ardzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung dang shin tu mnyam pa 74—241

dang ①/ shugs mnyam pa dang / mdzad pa mnyam pa dang / thabs mnyam pa ②brnyes par gyur nas/ 'dis nga mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyes par ma byas la/nga ⑧nyid kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung nas/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te/dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so// //bram ze gnyis pa ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan ④du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan ⑤du yod pa na bram ze zhig gnas pa des/ thabs duzlar bab dupa las chung ma blangs nas/ de de dang lhan cig tu ⑧ste zhing ⑨dga' la dga' mgur ⑩spyod pa las/ phyi zhig na de'i chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang bu btsas te/ rigs dang 'thun par 0ming btags nas/ de 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / ⑫ zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus ⑫bskyed bsrings 8te/ tsogang gi tshe cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ de yi ge bslabs sotso/ /bram ze ⑩rnams kyi lugs kyis na/ tshes brgyad dang tsobaco 8lnga'i nyin par bsang bar 0byed de/ res 0'ga' ni grong khyer ltar 3'gro'o/ /res 'ga' ni mu stegs ltar du'agro ba'am/ lha ltar 'gro ba'am/④ yam sreg ⑥shing thur tso'agro'o⑦ / /de nas phyi duzhig na 'bram ze'i khye'u des bsang 0dus la bab nas/rgyal bu rgyal byed ⑥kyi tshal du song ngo / /de'i 9tshe bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya phrag du ma'i nang na bzhugs shing chos ston tedu/ bram ze'i khye'u des thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas cibacom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong dunas kyang bcom ldan 'das la shin tu dga' bar gyur to/ /dga' bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste liphyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 0phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan ⑥pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'dug go0/ /de 74—242

nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i charkyen dang 'tsham pa'i ②chos bstan nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams la gnas par byas so/ /de nas des bcom ldan 'das kyi ①gtam gyi stimajug ⑤rdzogs par rig nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod cing yirjes su yi rangs ⑦nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi nizhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas6)/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de nas phyi zhig na bram ze'i khye'u des mchod sbyin bya bar brtsams nas/ bram ze'i khye'u mchod sbyin gyi gnas na 'dug pas bsams pa/gal te bcom ldan 'das mchod sbyin gyi gnas 'dir gshegs te/ longs spyod par mdzad cing / bcom ldan 'das gral 0gyi gtso 7la bzhugs na mchod sbyin gyi gnas mdzes par 'gyur ro 8snyam nas des bsams tunyepa/ bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs ④te/ kye ma tsobacom ldan 'das mchod sbyin gyi gnas 'dir longs spyod cing gshegs par gyur cig ces bsams sotso/ / de nas 0bram ze'i khye'u des sems bskyed ma thag tu/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal nas mi snang bar gyur te/ mchod sbyin gyi gnas su gshegs nas/ mi snang bar bram ze thams cad kyi gral gyi gtso tsol bzhugs so/ /bram ze'i khye'u des ni sangs rgyas ⑩bcom ldan 'das gral gyi gtso 0la bzhugs pa 0mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang bram ze'i khye'u des bcom ldan 'das bde bar bzhugs par ()rig dunas/ bza' ba dang bca' ba gtsang ma bzang po mang pos phyitshim par byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang mchod sbyin gyi gnas de longs spyod tshunas/mi snang bar bram ze thams cad la 'od zer btang tsonas rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal du gshegs so/ /de nas bram ze de dag gis mchod sbyin gyi gnas thams cad 74—243

snang ba chen pos khyab par mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang de dag na re bdag cag gi mchod sbyin grub po zhes zer ro/ /kha cig na re bdag cag gi 6)mchod sbyin gyi gnas su mi mjed ( kyi bdag po tshangs pa byung ngo ①zhes zer ro/ /gzhan kha cig na re (ge'adi (5)tshangs pa ma yin gyis(ye/ dbang phyug de bdag cag ( )gi mchod sbyin gyi gnas su gshegs so zhes zer ro/ /gzhan kha cig na re ni'adi 6)tshangs pa yang ma yin/ dbang phyug kyang ma yin gyisam/ khyab 'jug de bdag ⑩gi mchod sbyin gyi gnas 'dir byung 7ngo zhes zer ro/ /bram ze'i khye'u na re khyod lcogernams thams cad ni bslus pa yin te/ mchod sbyin gyi gnas 'dir ni bcom ldan 'das gshegs so zhes zer ro/ /de nas bram ze rnams 8bram ze'i tsokhye'u la yid ma ches nas/ bram ze'i khye'us smras pa/ bdag gis sang nang par ⑩khyed kyi mngon sum du 'gyur bar bya'o tunyezhes byas nas/ bram ze'i khye'u des phyi tunyenyin bram ze thams cad 'tshogs 4)pa'i nang du/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas kā / pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa btsugs du spenas/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal logs su phyogs te/ thal mo sbyar nas sems bskyed de tshig tu ()smras pa/btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ni 'di lta ste/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba ci yang mi mkhyen pa'am/ mi gzigs pa'am/ mi rtogs pa'am/(snyethugs su mi zhu skuchud pa ci yang mi mnga' na/ kye ma bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang / thabs cig ( natu bdag 0gi mchod sbyin gyi ( rteganas 'dir gshegs te longs spyod sa par gsol zhes byas so/ /de nas de skad ces brjod pa'i mod las// bcom ldan 'das dge slong mang pos zham ring 4 )byas te/dge slong gi dge 'dun gyis sheXmadun du bdar nas/ nam mkha' las mchod 74—244
