brtan 11gyi phyogs der bzhugs so/ /de nas yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo ②sbyangs gzugs can snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das (midage slong gi dge 'dun mang po dge slong stong dang thabs cig (getu yul ma ga sgyur ljongs rgyu zhing gshegs te/ yul ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi (snyemachod rten rab brtan zhes bya ba na/skyig (6)ma'i nags khrod du byon to zhes thos so/ /thos nas kyang rgyal po'i 'byor pa chen po dang / rgyal po'i mthu chen po dang / shing rta khri nyis stong dang /rgod ma stong brgyad brgya dang / yul ma ga dhā na gnas pa'i bram ze dang /khyim bdag stong phrag du ma dag dang thabs cig (7)tu rgyal po'i khab nas byung stedu/bcom ldan 'das la (9)blta ba dang / bcom ldan ⑩'das la bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ba las/ grong khyer gyi sgor byung ba na de'i mgo bo las cod 11pan lhung nas/ de 'di snyam du sems te bdag gis bcom ldan 'das blta ba ma legs pa zhig tu mi 'gyur grang snyam mo/ /de nas lha rnams kyis sbran 12pa/ 'di ni legs par 'gyur 4)te/ khyod kyis bcom ldan 'das la nga blta ba dang / bcom ldan 'das la bsnyen bkur tsobya ba ni legs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de lta mod kyis 7khyod gang dag dang spre tshodage ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa de dag kha cig ni khri mon du bcug cing 'dug /kha cig ni yul dag na 'dug gi/she/ rgyal po khyod kyis btson (7rnams gtang zu staba'i rigs so/ /ljongs dag tu yang zhu dril bsgrags te/ de dag dang ( gelhan cig so tu bcom ldan 'das la zhu4blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya ba'i phyir deng ( geshig ces byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu rgyal po gzugs can snying pos btson ( lharnams btang nas/yul na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po thams cad bsdus te/ 6)skye bo phal po che de phyi74—254

dag dang lhan cig tu yul ma ga dhā pa rnams kyi mchod rten rab brtan zhes bya ba na / phyig 0)ma'i nags khrod kyi rgyud thog thag tu song nas/ des rang gi dpung gi tshogs rnams la phyir bltas te/ des dmag tshogs chen po mthong nas rgyags pa skyes te/ byad gzugs dang mthu dbang nga (midang mtshungs pa med do snyam mo(kye / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas de bas kyang ches (4)blta na sdug pa dang / ches byad gzugs bzang po'i (gergyal po lnga brgya mngon par sprul nas/ de dag la chos ston cing bzhugs so/ /de nas yul ma (6)ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song nas/ de ji srid bzhon (7)pas 'gro bar bya ba'i sa ⑧de srid du bzhin (9)pa la zhon te song nas/ rgyal thabs rnam pa lnga ⑩ste/ gtsug tor dang ⑩/ gdugs dang / ral gri tshogadang / nor bu dang / rnga yab rnams dang / lham khra 12bo rnams bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nayi/ rgyal po ches gzugs bzang zhing ches mdzes pa lnga brgya chos nyan cing 'khod pa mthong nas de'i byad gzugs kyis rgyags pa gang yin pa de med par gyur to/ /de nas de 'di snyam du misems te/ gal te bdag gis bdag gi 7ming dang rus nas ma smos na/ bdag bcom ldan 'das kyis mi dgongs so snyam nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bla gos phrag 7pa gcig tu gzar tenyu)/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs (6nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de ( )logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de me/rang nigi ming (nyerus lan gsum gyi bar du smos te/ btsun pa bdag ni yul ma 74—255

ga ṅgā'i bdag 0)po bzo ②sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so/ /btsun pa bdag ni yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po lags so zhes byas so/ / de nas (mibacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po dhide ni de 6)yin te/ khyod ni yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po yin no/ /rgyal po chen po rang gi stan gang yin pa la 'dug cig /de nas yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos⑥/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag (7)'tshal nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /yul ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 2phyag 'tshal nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das dang mngon sum du yang dag par dga' bar 'gyur ba ⑨dang /yang dag par mgu bar 'gyur ba'i tshugatam rnam pa sna tshogs byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/nye/ /kha cig ni bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /kha cig ni thag ring po zhig nas / bcom ldan 'das mthong nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung tunyeral pa can yang 'khor de nyid du 'dus te (ste'adug go/ /de nas yul ma ga ṅgā'i 'bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ ci dge sbyong chen po de 'od srung gi thad na tshangs par 8spyad pa spyod dam/ 'on te lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can dge sbyong chen po'i thad na tshangs par spyad pa spyod zhig 7gu snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams kyi ()sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas/tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ lteng rgyas 74—256

gnas pa khyod kyis ①ci mthong na/ /'dir ni me spangs (midrang srong brtul ⑧ zhugs spangs/ /'od srung khyod kyis sbyin sreg ci'i ④phyir spangs/ /don de nga la kun nas brjod par gyis⑤/ /gsol pa/ 'di na (6)kha cig gzas dang btung ba rnams/ / khu bcud 'khor zhi)dang bud med bsngags par bgyid/ /de rnams phung po'i dri ma mthong khyabs na/ /bdag ni mchod sbyin me la dga' ma mchis / /bka' stsal pa/ khyod ni 'dod pa rnams la mi dga' zhing / /zas skom 0stan rnams la yang mi dga' na/ /khyod ni ji ltar lha mi'i (2'jig rten na//yid dga' 'od srung dris pa'i lan thob shig /gsol pa/ phung po med pa zhi ⑫bcom 8ci yang med/ /'dod dang srid la ma chags gzhan ④mi 'gyur/ /gzhan gyis dkrir 8med go 'phang mthong ⑩bas na/ /bdag ni mchod sbyin me la dga' ma mchis/ /mchod sbyin rnams dang brtul zhugs me ⑩rnams kyis/ /grol 8bar 'gyur snyam bdag gi yid kyang rmongs/ /'chi 'pho ma mchis gnas mchog ma mthong bas/ /skye 'chi'i 6)rjes 'brang bdag ni long bar gyur( )/ /mi mchog skyob pas legs gsungs zho nya'adus ma byas/ /go 'phang de ni (nyabadag gis da 'amathong ngo / /thub pa rnam ( )'dren gi 6tam bden pa'i rtsal/ /khyod ni skye bo mang phyir byung tsob lags/ /bka' stsal pa/ rab tu rnam par phye ba'i chos rnams la/ /gnas kyis gshegs (rtesu bab pa gang yin pa/ de ni khyod ( nyekyis legs par bsams pa yin/ /khyod kyis gtan la phebs pas legs 0par 'ongs / /'od srung 'khor rnams skyo ba rab bskyed 0cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng 0rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis ji ltar sems mnyam par bzhag pa de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ shar phyogs kyi steng gi nam mkha' 74—257

la mngon par 'phags nas/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhi byed de/ 'chag zhi)pa dang /sdod pa dang / 'dug pa dang / nyal bar byed do/ /me'i (gyikhams la snyoms par 'jug par byed de(mi/ tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can me'i khams la snyoms par zhugs pa'i lus las ④'od zer (snyernam pa sna tshogs byung ste/sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / btsod ka zhiradang / shel gyi kha dog lta bu rnams byung (7ngo / /cho (nya'aphrul zung du yang ston par byed dokyi)/ /lus kyi stod yinas ni me 'bar la/ lus kyi smad nas ni chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab bo/ /lus kyi smad nas ni 7me 'bar la'i/ lus kyi stod nas ni (1)chu grang mo'i rgyun 'bab bo/ /shar phyogs su ji lta ba de skibazhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs su yang de dang 'dra bar byas so/ /de nas tshe lidang ldan pa lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can gyis phyogs bzhir 7rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa bzhi tshubazhi bstan nas/ rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du byed pa bsdus te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar dzishenas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs yonate/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni bdag gi sum̐ )ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos lags so/ / bde bar gshegs pa ni ( nyabadag gi ston pa lags so/ /bdag ni bde bar gshegs pa'i nyan thos lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srung ri nyede ni de yin no/ /de ni de yin te/ 'od srung khyod kyi ston pa ni nga yin no/ /khyod ni nga'i nyan thos yin no/ /'od srung khyod rang gi stan ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug cig /de nas tshe dang ldan pa lteng rgyas 74—258

'od srung ral pa can rang gi stan (1)ji lta ba bzhin du 'dug go/ /de nas yul ma ga ṅgā'i phyibram ze dang / khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ lteng rgyas 'od srung ral pa can de chadage sbyong chen po gi ta ma'i thad na tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa yin gyis/ dge sbyong gi)chen po lteng rgyas 'od srung gi thad na tshangs par spyad pa spyod pa ni ma yin no snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul zhu)ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying po la bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po gzugs ni skye yang skye la (6)'grib kyang 'grib ste/ de'i skye ba yang rig par bya dgos la/ 'grib pa yang rig ji par bya dgos so/ /rgyal po chen po tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams (8)dang / rnam par shes pa yang skye yang skye la6)/ 'grib kyang 'grib 7ste/ de'i skye ba yang rig par bya dgos la/ 'grib pa (1yang rig par bya dgos so/ /rgyal po chen po gzugs skye ba dang / 'grib pa'i chos can yin par rig nas/ gzugs de yongs su shes so / /rgyal po chen po tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa yang 8skye ba dang / 'grib pa'i chos can yin par rig nas/rnam par shes pa de 6)yongs su shes so/ /rgyal po chen po gzugs yongs su shes na / gzugs de la bdag gi bdag 7yin no snyam du 'dzin par mi byed/ len par mi byed/ gnas par mi byed/ mngon par zhen par mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa yongs su shes na/ rnam par shes pa de la bdag gi bdag 8yin no snyam du 'dzin par mi byed/ len par mi byed / gnas par mi byed/ mngon par zhen par mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po gzugs la mi 'dzin/ mi len mi 74—259

gnas / mngon par zhen par mi byed na/ dpag tu med pa/ grangs med pa/mya ngan las 'das pa zhes nga zer ro/ /rgyal po chen po ①tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa la mi 'dzin/ mi len mi gnas / mngon par zhen par mi byed (min/ dpag tu med pa/ grangs med pa/mya ngan las 'das pa zhes nga chazer ro/ /de nas yul ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang /khyim bdag rnams 'di snyam du sems te/ ji ④ste gzugs bdag ma yin zhing /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa bdag ma yin na(snye/ bdag gam sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba'am/gso (6)ba'am/ gang zag gam/ shed bu'am/ shed can nam/ byed pa'am/byed pa po'am/ smra ba po'am/ tshor ba po'am/ skyed pa po'am/ kun tu skyed pa zhi)por su zhig 'gyur(gyi/ ma skyes shing / ma byung la 'byung ⑨bar mi 'gyur na yang kyiphung po 'di dag ni 'dor la/ phung po gzhan ni len par mi 'gyur ro snyam mo4)/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang ske/ khyim bdag rnams kyi sems thugs kyis mkhyen nas dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag bdag bdag ⑩ces bya ba ni/ so so'i skye bo thos pa dang mi ldan pa rnams kyis so sor bzung tsobar zad 8kyi/ 'di na bdag kyang med / bdag gi yang med do8/ /dge slong dag skye ba na/ sdug bsngal 'di nyid skye la/ 'gag pa na sdug bsngal 'di tshunyid 'gag go/ /skye ba na 'du byed rnams nyid skye la/ 'gag pa na 'du byed rnams nyid 'gag go/ /rgyu de dag dang rkyen de dag la ⑩brten nas/ sems can rnams kyi 'du byed kyi rgyud 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pas ni tsosems can rnams kyi 74—260

'du byed kyi rgyud kyi nying mtshams stisbyor ba thugs (7su chud nas/ 'chi 'pho dang ske/ skye ba ①'dogs par mdzad do/ /lha'i spyan rnam par dag pa mi'i ④las 'das pas sems can rnams 'chi 'pho zhing 'dug zhu)pa dang / skye zhing 'dug ⑥pa dang / kha dog bzang po dang ⑦/ ngan pa dang / bde 'gror 'gro ba rnams dang —/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba rnams dang (5)/ sems can las ji lta ba 6)bzhin du 'gro ba rnams ⑩yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /kye 4)sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis 8nyes par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / ngag gis ⑫nyes par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / yid kyis yinyes par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang ske/ 'phags pa tsornams la skur pa 'debs pa dang / log par lta ba dang /log par lta ba'i las dang / chos yang dag par yiblangs pa'i phyir rgyu de 'o)dang /rkyen des lus dang bral te/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i tsosems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kye tho)sems can 'di dag ni lus kyis tsolegs par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / ngag gis (7legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang / yid kyis ( gelegs par spyod pa dang ldan pa dang /'phags pa rnams la skur pa mi 'debs pa dang / yang dag par lta ba dang /yang dag pa'i dulas dang / chos yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir rgyu de dang rkyen 4des lus dang bral te/ shi ba'i 'og tu bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi ④lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag ngas de ltar shes shing de ltar mthong bas na/ nga ni 'di skad du/ nga ni bdag de (2yin no zhe'amatso/ nga ni sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba'am/ gso ba'am/ gang zag gam/shed bu'am/ shed can nam/ byed pa'am/ byed pa po'am/ smra ba po'am/74—261

tshor ba po'am/ skyed pa po'am(11/ kun du skyed (snyepa po yin no zhes mi zer ro/ /ma skyes shing ma byung la 'byung bar mi 'gyur na yang / phung po 'di dag ni 'dor la / phung po gzhan ni len par mi 'gyur ro snyam du mi 'dzin to/ /chos kyi brda 6)tsam ni ma gtogs so54)/ /de la chos kyi brda (5)ni 'di lta ste/ 'di yod na 'di 'byung la/ 'di 47skyes pas 'di skye bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams 'byung 577/ 'du byed rnams (8)kyi rkyen gyis rnam par shes pa 59'byung / rnam par shes pa'i rkyen gyis ming dang gzugs 'byung /ming dang gzugs kyi rkyen gyis skye mched drug 'byung / skye mched drug gi rkyen gyis reg pa 'byung / reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba 'byung / tshor ba'i rkyen gyis sred pa 'byung / srid pa'i rkyen gyis len pa 'byung / len pa'i rkyen gyis srid pa 'byung / srid pa'i rkyen gyis skye ba 'byung / skye ba'i rkyen 7gyis rga shi dang /mya ngan dang / smre sngags 1lha'adon pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug 12pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig pa sna 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'di lta ste/ 'di med na 'di mi 'byung lasko/ 'di 'gags pas 'di 'gag par 'gyur te/'di lta ste/ ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed rnams 'gagatso /'du byed rnams 'gags pas rnam par shes pa 'gag /rnam par shes pa 'gags pas ming dang gzugs 'gag /ming dang gzugs 'gags pas skye mched drug 'gag /skye mched drug 'gags pas reg pa 'gag /reg pa 'gags ⑩pas tshor ba 'gag /tshor ba 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /sred pa ⑩'gags pas len pa 'gag /len pa 'gags pas srid pa 'gag /srid pa 'gags pas skye 74—262

ba 'gag /skye ba 'gags pas/ rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams 'gag par 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 0)'ba' zhig pa ②'di 'gag par 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dag de ltar na (5)rgyu byung na/sdug bsngal 'byung bar 'gyur la/ rgyu 'gags (gan sdug bsngal 'gag par 'gyur te/ lam chad pas 'jug par mi 'gyur la/ nying mtshams (5)sbyor ba med pas 'gag 6)par 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal gyi mtha' ni de (7)kho na yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs 55)gzugs can snying po la lan gnyis su bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/gzugs rtag pa yin nam/ mi rtag pa yin/ gsol pa btsun pa de ni mi rtag pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ mi rtag pa gang yin pa de sdug bsngal ba kyi)yin nam / sdug bsngal ba ma yin/ gsol pa/ btsun pa de ni sdug 7bsngal ba lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ mi rtag cing sdug bsngal lanyinya/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can gang yin pa de la ci thos pa dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa 1nyanyan thos bdag tu 'dzin cing / 'di ni bdag gi yin no/ /'di ni bdag yin no/ /'di ni bdag gi bdag yin no snyam du 'dzin tam/ gsol pa/ btsun pa de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po ji snyam du sems/ tshor ba dang ske/ 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa rtag pa yin nam/ mi rtag pa yin/ gsol pa/ btsun pa de ni mi rtag pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ mi rtag pa gang yin pa de 3nyesdug bsngal ba yin nam/ sdug bsngal ba ma yin/ gsol pa/ btsun pa de ni sdug bsngal ba lags so8/ /74—263

bka' stsal pa/1) mi rtag cing sdug bsngal la/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i chos can gang (nasayin pa de la/ ci thos pa dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa nyan ①thos bdag tu 'dzin cing / 'di ni bdag gi yin no/ /④'di ni bdag yin no/ /'di ni phyibadag gi bdag (6)yin no snyam du 'dzin tam/ gsol pa/ btsun pa de ni ma lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po de bas na gzugs gang yang rung ste / 'das (7pa dang / ma 'ongs pa (snyedang / da ltar byung ba nang gi'am/phyi rol gyi'am/ rags pa'am/ cha phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ bzang po'am/nye ba'am/ ring ba gang yang dzi)rung ba de dag thams cad ni bdag gi yang ma yin / de ni bdag kyang ma yin/ de ni bdag gi bdag kyang ma yin 0te/de kho na ltar yang dag pa (1ji lta ba bzhin du yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /rgyal po chen po ji snyam du 7sems/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa gang yang rung ste/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba nang gi'am/ phyi rol gyi'am/rags pa'am/ cha phra ba'am/ ngan pa'am/ bzang po'am/ nye ba'am/ring ba gang yang rung ba de dag thams cad ni bdag gi yang ma yin⑩/ de ni bdag kyang ma yin/ de ni bdag gi bdag kyang ma yin te/ de kho na ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis blta bar bya'o/ /de ltar mthong ba'i tustethos pa dang ldan pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos ni gzugs las skyo bar 'gyur ro/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang /rnam par shes pa las skyo bar 'gyur ro/ /skyo na ma chags par 'gyur ro/ /ma chags na rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par grol na bdag ni rnam par 74—264

grol lo snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug ste0)/ bdag gi skye ba ni zad (kyedo/ /tshangs par spyod ③pa ni ⑦spyad zin to⑤/ /bya ba ni 4)byas so/ /srid pa 'di las gzhan med do snyam du ye shes gzigs pa 'jug go/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa na/ yul ma ga ṅgā'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs ( nyecan snying po la sogs pa ⑧lha brgyad khri dang / yul ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag stong phrag du ma chos ⑨rnams la 7chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba (1skyes so//de nas yul ma ga d+ma'i rgyal po bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying pos chos mthong 5)/chos rnyed/ chos rtogs/ chos kyi gting slebs/ som nyi las brgal6nya/ the tsom ⑫ las brgal 8te/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog cing gzhan gyis kri 7ba med la ston pa'i ⑩bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar (shenas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal yimo sbyar ba btud desokye/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad mnyaces gsol to//btsun pa bdag ni 'phags ( grelags so/ / 'phags lags so/ / 3)btsun pa bdag ni sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge slong gi (stedage 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag deng slan chad ( geji srid 'tsho'i ( nyabar du khong nas dad pa'i dge bsnyen 0lags par (sregazung ( )du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu gshegs su gsol/ bdag gis bcom ldan 'das dang / dge slong gi dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur bgyi'o/ /ji ( 2srid 'tsho'i bar du bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i na bza' dang / zhal zas dang /gzims 0cha dang / stan rdunyedang / snyun (rtegasos 5zedang / sman zong rnams sbyar bar 'tshal lo zhes gsol to/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas 74—265

bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa0)/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ②rgyal po gzugs can snying po la sogs pa (5)lha brgyad chakhri dang yul ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag stong phrag du ma skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang (5)/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug 56)pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod pa dang / gzhi de las bcom ldan 'das kyi grags pas ⑦'jig rten kun tu rgyas par gyur pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang rgyal po gzugs can snying po la sogs pa (9lha brgyad khri dang / yul ma dhig d+ma'i bram ⑩ze dang / khyim bdag stong phrag du ma mang po 'di rnams bsam gtan bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga dang / dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la ngas ji ltar bkod pa dang / gzhi des na nga'i (1grags pas 'jig rten du rgyas 8par gyur pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ grong khyer rdul ldan zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag po zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de1)/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang 6/ rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang /'khrug pa dang / nang 'khrug dang /ma chom rkun dang / nad dang / mu ge med pa dang / 'bras sā 7lu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma he dang ldan par 'dug stenyu / gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs la/ bu gcig nyurtepa sdug pa nyunyel bya ba bzhin du chos bzhin du 4 )rgyal srid byed do/ /de nas rgyal po de btsun mo dang / lhan cig nu)rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod pa las btsun mo la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang / bu 74—266

gzugs bzang zhing blta na sdug la zhi)mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston rgyas par byas nas/ ming rdul zhes bya bar brtags (2so/ /de nas khye'u rdul pang na 'tsho ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / nu ma snun rgyas pa'i ma ma gnyis dang / dri ma 'khru ba'i ma ma gnyis dang / rtse ba'i ma ma gnyis te( )/ ma ma brgyad la (5)gtad (6nasal/ de ma ma brgyad kyis6)/ 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gu (8)dang / gzhan yang yo byad kyi khyad par bzang ngo cog 6)gis bskyed bsrings te/ mtsho'i bonang gi pad ma bzhin du skye drag par gyur to/ /de nas de yigang gi tshe cher yo skyes pa de'i tshe/ khye'u de yi ge slob tu bcug ste(nya/ rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur 1 ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi 7bzo'i gnas dang / las kyi yiganas tha dad pa 'di lta ste/ glang po che bzhon tu 7pa dang ske/ rta bzhon yi pa dang / mtshon cha (/6 bcang ba 2 tshodang / 'phong dang /mdun du bsnur (7ba dang / phyir bsnur ba dang / g.yul las thar bar bya ba dang ske/ lcags kyus ( cigegazung ( snyeb dang / zhags pas 3 tshogazung 6geb dang /mda' bo che 'phang ba dang / 37rdo rje rtse gcig pa 'phang ba dang / mtshon rtse gcig pa gdab pa dang / 'khor lo 'phang ba dang / gcad ( 7pa dang /gsheg 6)pa dang / lag pas gzung 29ba dang / rkang pa'i stabs tsho tshodang / mgo bo bskyab (nyapa dang / rgyang mar 'phang ba dang / sgra grags par 'phang ba dang /gnad du phog pa 8shedang / gdon mi za bar phog par bya ba 5nyadang / tshabs cher gtang ba tsornams kyang bslabs nas gnas lnga la byang bar risagyur to/ /rgyal po phyogs kyi dulhabadag po'i mdun na 'don ni bram ze khyim bdag tsho 7khyab 'jug ces bya ba yin te/ de yang mkhas shing gsal la yid gzhungs pa/ rtsis mgo'i sa 74—267

thabs shes pa'i shes rab dang / dpyod 6)pa dang ldan pa zhig ste/ de rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag po'i rgyal po'i 'phrin zhu)las su bya ba thams cad byed la/ rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag pos kyang / mdun na 'don bram ze khyab 'jug de khyil rgyal srid gtad nas/ khang bzangs kyi ⑤steng na 'dug cing (5)bud med 'ba' zhig dang ske/ sil snyan ⑦gyis rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur spyod do/ /phyi zhig na bram ze khyab 'jug gi chung ma la bu chags nas/ de zla ba dgu'am bcu lon pa dang / bu gzugs bzang zhing blta (8sten sdug la mdzes pa zhig btsas te/ de'i btsas ston rgyas par byas te6)/ khye'u'i ⑩ming me skyong zhes btags so/ /de nas khye'u me skyong 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / mar gyi nying gus (1bskyed bsrings teyi/ de tsogang gi tshe 8cher skyes pa de'i tshe/ yi ge dang /'a bram ze'i spyod lam dang / spyod pa dang / oṃ zhes bya ba dang /bho zhes bya ba dang / gtsang sbra dang / cho ga dang / thal ba blang ba ⑩dang /ril ba thogs pa dang / nges brjod kyi rig 7byed dang / mchod sbyin gyi rig (3byed dang / snyan tshig gi rig byed dang / srid srung gi rig byed dang /mchod sbyin bya ba dang / mchod sbyin 7byed du gzhug gu pa dang / sbyin pa dang /blang ba dang / kha ton bya ba dang 0/ kha don slob tu gzhug pa'i 0thabs bslabs nas/ las rnam pa drug la mkhas pa'i bram zer gyur te/ de mthar gyis rig pa'i gnas bcwa (nyebargyad la byang ④bar gyur (geto/ /de nas de'i phas khye'u me skyong la smras pa/ bu khyod ⑩ni yab 'das pa'i 'og tu yab kyi thabs kyi rgyal ( nyesar (3'jug par 'gyur la/ khyod ni 'di'i mdun na 'don du 'gyur gyi0/'di la khyod 6 )kyis 0skor 6cig /snga nas bskor dudang / khyod la 'bras bu yod 74—268

par 'gyur ro/ /me skyong gis smras pa/ jo bos ji skad bka' stsal pa bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes smras nas/ gzhon nu rdul gyi ①phyi bzhin du grib ma bzhin du ②'brang ngo / /de nas phyi zhig na bram ze khyab 'jug shi nas/ de shi ba'i phyir ⑧rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag po shin tu mya ngan byed cing / sdug bsngal la gasmre sngags 'don par byed do/ /de nas gzhon nu rdul gyis gsol pa/ lha khyod ci'i slad du bram ze khyab 'jug gum pa'i slad du/ shin tu thugs ngan mdzad cing 'o brgyal dul/ smre sngags 'don cing bzhugs/ rgyal pos smras pa/ bram ze khyab 'jug ni nga'i rgyal po'i phrin ⑥las su zhi)bya ba thams cad byed nibyed de/ de'i mthus pa'i dhisnying khral chung ngur ⑩'dug go/ /gzhon nu rdul gyis gsol pa/lha khyod bram ze khyab 'jug gum pa'i slad du ha cang thugs ngan ma mdzad/ ha cang 'o brgyal 0bar ma mdzad ha cang smre 6)sngags 'don par ma mdzad cig dang /lha tsomakhan po de nyid kyi ④bu bram ze'i khye'u me skyong zhes bgyi 8ba/ pha bas kyang ches khyad par du 'phags pa zhig mchis pa de/ lhas mdun yin 'don du bsko ⑩bar gsol/ 'on tang 8des lha'i rgyal po'i phrin 6)las su ( )bgyi ba thams cad bgyid ⑥par 'gyur ro/ /de nas de 4)thos ma thag tu rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag pos / bram ze'i khye'u me skyong dgug 0pa btang nas mdun na 'don du bcug gol/ /de tsonas des kyang rgyal po de'i bya ba thams cad nyams su blangs so/ /de nas phyi zhig na rgyal po phyogs kyi bdag pos/ gzhon nu rdul ( nyergyal sar bcug tsonas/ phyogs kyi rdzu )bdag po shi'o/ /de nas de'i ming gzhon nu rdul zhes bya ba de med par gyur nas/ rgyal po rdul phyizhes bya bar gyur to0/ /de nas rgyal po rdul gyis kyang 0bram ze'i khye'u me skyong dgug (sprepa btang nas/ de la 74—269

smras pa/ mkhan po khyod kyis ci 1)ltar nga'i yab kyi rgyal po'i phrin chalas su bya ba thams cad byas pa de bzhin du nga'i yang gyis shig /bram ze'i khye'us gsol pa/lha de bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes gsol nas/ bram ze'i khye'u (mime skyong gis rgyal po rdul gyi rgyal srid kyi bya ba thams cad nyams su blangs so/ /de nas de'i ming me skyong zhes bya ba gang (4)yin pa de med par gyur nas/ me skyong khyab 'jug ces bya bar gyur to(5)/ /de'i tshe rgyal po rdul gyi sngon gzhon nu'i tshe/ mdza' zhing bshes la 6)gcugs pa/ rgyal rigs gzhon nu drug cig yod pa de dag /rgyal po de'i thad du 'ongs nas smras pa/ lhas bdag cag gi yul dbog (7)tu gsol/ de nas de thos ma thag tu rgyal pos me skyong khyab 'jug la bka' stsal te(8)/ mkhan po khyod kyis sa chen po 'di cha bdun du bgos la6)/ cha drug ni gzhon nu 'di rnams la byin cig /cha gcig 7ni nga'i bya'o/ /des gsol pa/ lha hunyede bzhin du 'tshal lo zhes byas 32nas/ me skyong khyab 'jug gis sa chen po 'di tu)cha bdun du bgos te/ cha drug ni gzhon nu drug po rnams la byin no/ /cha gcig yini ⑫rgyal po rdul gyi skal bar lus shing 'dug go/ /de nas rgyal po rdul gyis rgyal rigs tshadrug po de dag rang hu snarang gi rgyal srid la bkod do/ /de nas me skyong khyab 'jug dzi ni 'dzam bu'i 47gling /nu )du tshangs par bkur te/ bram ze khyab 'jug ni tshangs pa'i lam yin no snyam du 'dzin cing / tshangs pa'i lam yin par blta'o / /de nas phyi zhig na/ bram ze khyab 'jug 'di snyam du sems te( tre/bdag ni rgyal khams thams cad kyi mi rnams kyis tshangs par bkur te/ bram ze khyab 'jug ni tshangs pa'i lam yin no snyam du 'dzin cing / tshangs pa'i lam yin par lta la/ gna'i na bram ze rgas shing 'khogs la 'gatugs (stepa/ sde tshan 8gle74—270

gyi slob dpon chen po dag las bdag gis 0)thos na/ bram ze gang gis ②dbyar zla ba ①bzhi'i bar du byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas pa de la/ mi mjed ④kyi bdag po tshangs pa bltar (5)'ong ngo zhes zer gyis (6)ma la bdag gis (7)thams cad spangs te/ khang bzangs kyi (kyesteng du song la/ byams pa dang /snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang / ldan pa'i sems kyis dzi)gnas par bya gor ma chag snyam nas/ rgyal po la gsol pa/ lha mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag ni dbyar zla ba bzhi tshangs 7pa'i gnas kyis (rmiganas par 8'tshal te/ de bas na yi lhas lha nyid kyi 8rgyal po'i phrin 7las su bgyi ba gang lags pa thams cad bgyid pa'i mdun na 'don gzhan zhig bsgo tsobar gsol zhes smras tu so/ /de nas rgyal po rdul gyis smras pa/ khyod ci ltar dga' ba de tsobazhin du bya'o/ /de nas de thos (dzom thag tu bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos ( tsholas su bya ba thams cad spangs nas/ khang bzangs kyi ( 1steng du song stezhuge/khang bzangs kyi (stesteng na 'dug ( stecing / byams pa dang / snying rje dang /dga' ba dang / btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems kyis gnas so/ /de nas phyi zhig na de la mi mjed ri(gekyi bdag po lhatshangs pa bltar 3 sna'ongs nas/ mi mjed ()kyi bdag po tshangs pa'i 29kha dog gi mthus/ khang bzangs sa de dag thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur to/ /de nas de mthong nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bdag gis sa7kha dog 'di 'dra ba/ / sngon cad ma thos ma mthong stezhu/ /kha dog bzang ༷rtezhing gzugs bzang ba/ /grogs po khyod ni su khri)zhig lags/ /mi mjed (nyakyi bdag po tshangs pas smras pa/ gzhon nu brgya byin la sogs dang (sgo/ /de bzhin lus can gzhan dag kyang / /bdag ni ( 〉tshangs 74—271

pa'i lus su shes/ /khyab 'jug de ltar shes par gyis/ /bram ze che zhing ma thob 6)khyab 'jug gis smras pa/ tshangs pa khyod la 'dud par bgyi/ /tshangs pa khyod la mchod par 'tshal(mi/ bdag gi tshig ni gsan rgyanas kyang / /lan ④ni myur du bka' stsol cig /mi mjed (gekyi bdag po tshangs pas smras pasayi/ khyab 'jug khyod kyis smras pa yi/ /tshig ni bdag gis gzung ⑦bar bya/ /'dri nib yid la ci 'dod pa/ /bram zes po)nga la dri tshubar gyis/ /tshe 'di yi ⑩ni don yang rung / /phyi ma'i tshe yi 8don yang rung / /khyod kyis dris pa de dang de/ /ngas ni nges par dpyad 8par bya/ /bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/bdag gi the tsom gzhan brtags 8the tsom rnams/ /bram ze kun 'gyed tsogazhon nu dri bar gyisatso/ /gang la gnas shing ci la bslab bgyis na⑩/ /rdul med mi yis (nyetshangs pa'i 'jig rten thob/ /mi mjed ⑩kyi bdag po tshangs pas smras pa/tshangs pa mi yis ( steng rgyal spangs (7byas la/ /rtse gcig btud de snying rjes ⑤mos byas shing / /dri nga med cing 'khrig pa durab spangs la( ste/ /de la gnas shing de la bslab byas nas( nye/ /rdul med mi yis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten thob( nya/ /bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/ tshangs pa gang dag mi yi 6)dri nga lags/ /chu 'gram chus khri yog ( lebazhin du gang gis g.yogs/ /ngan 4)song rgyu ste 0'jig rten thams cad bsgribs/ /tshangs pa thob ④pa'i lam yang yong dumi shes/ /mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas 0smras pa/ khro tsodang brdzun tsodang ngan sems 'tshe ba dang / /ngan du byed dang blo phyed 0phra ma dang / /chags dang sdang dang de bzhin gti mug dang / /'chab pa dang ni ser sna gtum tshig rnams/ /bram ze 'di dag mi yi ⑥dri nga ba/ /chu 'gram chus yog tsobazhin du de yis zhugayogs/ /74—272

ngan song rgyu ste ①'jig rten thams cad bsgribs(gyi/ /tshangs pa thob ①pa'i ④lam yang yong dumi shes/ /chos 'di rtag tu spyod pa yin/ /de rnams las ni 'das gyur na/ /tshangs pa dag tu skye 'gyur gyis/ /khyod kyi brtan por bsgrims ⑥par gyis/ /de skad ces smras nas/ mi mjed ⑦kyi bdag po tshangs pa de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /mi mjed (nyekyi bdag po tshangs pa mi snang bar gyur nas / /ring po ma lon par bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos bsams pa mi mjed ①kyi bdag po tshangs pas ji skad bshad pa'i don bdag gis shes te/ 'di ltar bdag khyim par 'dug ste/ khyim na gnas bzhin du ni gcig tu brtul te/ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshangs par spyod pa ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa7/yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba spyad par dka' yin/ ma la bdag gis skra dang kha spu bregs te gos tshon 7can rnams bgos la/ yang dag pa'i dad pas khyim nas khyim med ⑩par rab tu 'byung bar bya gor ma 8chag snyam mo/ /de nas phyi zhig na rgyal po rdul/ bram ze khyab 'jug chen po ga la ba der song ste phyin nas / bram ze khyab 'jug chen po'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go⑩/ /de nas bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos rgyal po rdul tsol 'di skad ces smras so/ /yul bdag rgyal chen 9rdul gyis ni/ /de ring bdag gi 8tshig gson cigatso /khyod nyid kyis ni rgyal srid srungs nya/ /khyab 'jug bdag ni spro ba med/ /rgyal po rdul gyis smras pa/ khyod kyi 0'dod pa ma skongs pa ༷ / /de ni bdag gis nges par bskang ⑫/ /khyod kyi gnod pa bdag gis bsalaphyi / /khyab 'jug bdag ni ma dor cig /khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/bdag ni du'adod pa ma skongs dumed/ /bdag la gnod pa byed pa'ang med/ /74—273

mi ma yin pa'i tshig thos nas/ /khyim na gnas par spro ba med/ /rgyal po rdul gyis smras pa/ bram ze su yi 3)tshig thos pas/ /nga (snyedang 'dod pa spong byed pa/ /mi ma yin pa ci 'dra ba(9/ /dris pa de ni bdag la smros/ /khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/ snying rje la ni gnas nas kyang / /dben ④pa'i bsam gtan byed pa na57 / /de tshe tshangs pa byung nas ni/ /phyogs rnams thams cad snang bar byas/ /bdag gis de yi (6)tshig thos nas/ /khyim na phyaganas pa (8)spro ba med/ /rgyal po rdul gyis smras pa/ mkhan po khyod nam bdag gi bu thu yi)bo rgyal sar ma bcug gi bar du sdod cig dang / mkhan po rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag kyang rab tu 'byung 7bar bya'o zhes smras nas tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ bram ze gang du 'gro ba deratsho1/ /bdag kyang der ni 'gro bar tsobya/ /bdag gis tsho/nyekhyod kyi slob ma byedamu/ /bdag gi ston pa khyab 'jug khyod/ /khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/so so'i 8skye bo gar chags pa/ /'dod pa de ni spangs par gyis7/ /'dod pa rnams la ma lta 9bar/ /bden pa'i chos tshoshel gnas par gyis/ /rgyal po rdul gyis smras pa/ tshangs pa dag par 4)skye ba'i phyir/ /nam mkha' ( )dri med lta bu dang / /nor bu be+e drur+ya dag 5 steltar/ /tshangs par spyod pa spyad zhu par bya/ /khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/ rgyal po chen po zhu de'i dus la bab par mkhyen na/de ltar mdzod cig (steces byas nas/ bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po drug la smras pa/ kye bdag ni skra shusnyedang kha spu bregs te/ chos zho nyagos tshon can bgos la/ yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas ji tshokhyim nas khyim med par rab tu 'byung ( 2bar 'dod na/ khyod zhu)ji ltar byed( dī/ de dag gis smras pa/ mkhan po khyod zhunyalo bdun gyi bar du sdod cig dang / lo bdun lon nas bdag cag gi cu74wa 274

bu dang nu bo ①dag rgyal sar bcug la/ mkhan po rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag cag kyang rab tu 'byung ngo / /khyab 'jug chen pos smras pa/ kye lo bdun ni ha cang yun ring ( ches so/ /'dod pa rnams ni chags par 'gyur ba'ol/ /longs spyod rnams (geni rgyags par 'gyur ba'o/ /'tsho ba dang 'chi ba ni drod gzung ④dka'o/ /lo bdun lon nas khyod (5)rab tu 'byung (6cingam mi 'byung yang gtol med kyis(7)/ bdag je rab tu 'byung (8 ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/mkhan po khyod re zhig sdod cig dang / lo drug gam/ lnga'am/ bzhi'am/gsum mam6)/ gnyis sam/ gcig gam/ de bzhin du zla ba yibadun nam/drug gam/ lnga'am/ bzhi'am/ gsum mamanyate/ gnyis sam/ gcig gam/zhag bdun nam/ drug gam/ lnga'am/ bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis sam / gcig 8lon na(rnye/ bdag cag gis co bu dang tshan bo rnams rgyal sar bcug nas/ mkhan po rab tu byung ba'i rjes su bdag cag kyang rab tu byung tshungo ske/ /khyab 'jug gis smras pa/ kye zhag bdun yang ha cang yang (1yun ma rings samatunye/ 'dod pa rnams ni chags par 'gyur ba'am16/ longs spyod pa rnams ni rgyags par 'gyur ba'amasarta/ 'tsho ba dang / 'chi ba'i 2 drod gzung ( snyedaka'ol/ /zhag bdun lon nas kyang khyod ri rirab tu 'byung ngam/ mi 'byung gtol med kyis (nyebadag je rab tu 'byung ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ zhag bdun yang btang ste( 9/ deng nyid du bdag cag gi 7bu dang nu bo dag rgyal sar bcug nas/ mkhan po tsho snyerab tu 'byung 39ba'i rjes su bdag cag kyang rab tu 'byung ngo / /khyab 'jug gis smras pa/ khyed kyis de'i dus la bab par shes na/de ltar gyis shig /de nas bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos/ rgyal rigs kyi rgyal 74—275

po drug gi 'khor bltas ①nas/ bram ze che zhing mtho ba bdun bltas so/ /bram ze che zhing mtho ba bdun bltas nas/ bshes pa'i bud med bzhi bcu bltas so / /bshes pa'i bud med bzhi bcu bltas ②nas/ bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya bltas so/ /bram ze'i khye'u ②lnga brgya bltas nas/ shing rta ④kha lo ba rnams dang /glang po che'i kha lo ba rnams dang / rta pa rnams dang / shing rta pa ⑤rnams dang /mtshon cha can 6)rnams dang / 'phong ba ⑦rnams dang / zham niring ⑨ba rnams dang / tshal za ba rnams dang / drag shul can rnams dang / dpa' bo rnams dang / rab gnon ⑩rnams dang / tshan po che chen po rnams dang /rgyal po'i sras du ma dag bltas te/ kye bdag ni skra dang kha spu bregs nas/gos tshon rmenyacan rnams bgos la yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas 8khyim med par rab tu 'byung yin khyed ci ④ltar byed semasatso/ de dag gis smras gtso/bdag cag kyang mkhan 0po ra ba tu 'byung tsoba'i rjes su rab tu 'byung ngo / /khyab 'jug gis smras pa/ khyed ⑩kyis so)de'i dus la 0bab par shes na/ de bzhin du ()gyis shig ces byas nasadu/ bram ze khyab 'jug chen pos khyim gyi 'khor thams cad btang ste④/ sbyin pa dag byin zhing bsod nams dag ⑥byas te / du ma zhig khyadabul por te tshubatang nas/ skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos tshon ducan rnams bgos nas/ yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas 9khyim med par rab tu byung 63 ngo / /rab tu byung nas kyang nags khrod cig 0tu gnas bcas nas/ yal ga dudang lo ma'i spyil po phub ⑥ste/ de de na 'dug nas bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed de⑥/ rdzu 'phrul che zhing mthu che bar gyur to④/ /khyab 'jug rab tu byung nas rgyal po rdul g.yog 'khor 74—276

'bum phrag ①du ma dang ②/ skra dang kha spu bregs te/ (bgos tshon ④can rnams bgos nas/ yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas khyim ⑤med par rab tu byung ngo / /de bzhin du rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po drug gi 'khor dang / bram ze che zhing mtho ba bdun dang / bshes pa'i bud med bzhi bcu dang / bram ze'i khye'u lnga brgya dang / shing rta'i kha lo pa rnams dang / glang po che'i kha lo pa rnams dang / rta pa rnams dang / shing rta pa rnams dang / mtshon cha can rnams dang ⑥/ zham phyaring ba rnams dang / tshal za ba (kyernams dang / drag shul can rnams dang / dpa' bo 6)rnams dang / rab gnon pa ⑩rnams dang /tshan po che chen po rnams dang / rgyal po'i sras du ma dag (nyaspa dang kha spu bregs te / gos tshon can rnams bgos nas/ yang dag pa'i dad pa kho nas khyim nas 8khyim med par khyab 'jug rab tu byung ba'i rjes su rab tu byung ste7/ bram ze khyab 'jug gis thams cad ④la tsoyid la byed pa'i lung phog nas/ de dag gis kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrub ⑩pa dang / 'bad pas bsam gtan bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do/ /de nas bram ze 7che zhing mtho ba khyab 'jug gi ming bram ze che zhing mtho ba khyab 'jug ces bya bar gyur pa de med par gyur nas/ston pa khyab 'jug ces bya bar gyur to/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/de'i tshe ston pa khyab 'jug ces bya tsobar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no//de'i tshe rgyal po rdul ces bya bar gyur pa gang yin (7pa de ni/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po 'di kho na yin no/ /de'i tshe rgyal po rdul gyis mgo drangs pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag du mar gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ༅ni/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mgo drangs pa'i lha brgyad 0khri dang / yul ma ga d+ma'i bram ze dang / khyim 74—277

bdag stong phrag du ma 91)mang po 'di dag kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang ngas rgyal po rdul la sogs pa yul gyi mi du ma dang / bram ze dang / khyim bdag stong phrag du ma rab tu byung nas/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la bkod de/ gzhi (7des na nga'i (5)grags pas 'jig rten rgyas par gyur to④/ /da ltar yang ngas ri5)rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang (6)/ lha brgyad khri dang / ma ga ṅgā'i bram ze dang / khyim bdag stong phrag du ma dam pa'i chos kyi 97)bcud kyis tshim par byas nas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod do// // las brgya tham pa/58 bam po sum cu po bdun pa ste tha ma'i/ 'thab 7mo zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe mnyan du yod 51 pa na skye bo phal po che tsho 'thab pa dang / mtshang 'dru 8ba dang / 'gyed pa dang / rtsod dpa la zhugs shing 'khod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bgrod pa gcig pu'i lam ston pa/ rnam pa gnyis kyi shes bya dang / ye shes la mnga' brnyes 4pa/ ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum la mkhas pa/mi 'jigs pa bzhis mi 'jigs pa/ 'gro ba 7lngar 'gro ba las rnam par grol ba / skye mched drug la mkhas pa/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la spyod yul ba/rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu la snyoms par 'jug pa/ stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa/yang dag pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs tsho pa rnams ni chos nyid kyis (7nyin dus gsum mtshan dus gsum ste/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis 'jig rten la gzigs te/ su ni rgud/ su ni dar/ su ni phongs sushing 74—278

'dug /su ni nyam 0)nga bar gyur(na/ su ni gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni phongs rinapa dang nyam ④nga ba dang gnod pa dang ldan/ su ni ngan song du gzhol/ su ni ngan song du 'bab/ su ni ngan song du bab/ su ni ngas 55snangan song nas phyung ste(5) / mtho ris dang thar pa dang 'bras bu la gzhag par bya/ su ni nyes par spyod pa'i 'dam du bying ba las lag nas drang bar bya/ su ni 'phags pa'i nor bdun med pa las/ 'phags pa'i nor bdun gyi dbang phyug la dbang byed du gzhug par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams ma bskyed 79pa las bskyed par bya/su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams (8)bskyed zin pa las yongs su smin par bya/ su ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su smin zin pa las ye shes kyi mtshon 99)gyis brtol bar bya/ su la ni sangs rgyas byung 7bas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten 'bras bu yod par bya snyam du ye shes gzigs 47pa 'jug go/ /rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi yinaganasal/ /dus rlabs yol bar 'gyur yang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las yol ba med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ skye bo phal po kyi che gdul ba'i dus la bab ste/ de dag ngas a+yo'athab pa dang / mtshang 'dru skob dang / 'gyed pa dang / rtsog 7pa las bzlog ste/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la dgod par bya 7snyam du dgongs nas/ snga dro sham thabs dang chos gos gsol te/ lhung bzed bsnams nas/ mnyan du yod par bsod snyoms la gshegs te/ skye bo phal po che ga la ba der 18gshegs nas/ skye bo phal po che de dag gis thag ring po zhig nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang ngo mtshar tsho'obar gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi slo 7phyir gdan 74—279

bshams 3)nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa legs so legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs bzhugs su gsol/ de nas gdan bshams pa la bzhugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che la bka' stsal pa/grogs po dag ci byed cing 'khod gzhan dang 'thab dgos na gzhan dang 'thab cing 'dug gam(ge/ de rnams kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag su dang 'thab 'tshal lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' nistsal pa/ grogs po dag 'o na 'khod cig 4)dang / ngas khyod (snyel rgyas par bshad ⑥par bya'o/ /de nas skye bo phal po che de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir spyan sngar 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan ⑦'das kyis skye bo phal po che 6)de dag la bka' stsal pa/ khyod ①ni nyon mongs pa rnams dang 'thab dgos kyis7/ nyon mongs pa spong ba'i 7phyir 'bad par gyis shig ces tshubacom ldan 'das kyis de dag la de lta bu dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na de dag gi khro ba'i kun nas dkris 8pa med par gyur nas/stan de dag nyid la 'khod bzhin du 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu ye shes rdo rjes bcom nas/ rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mngon sum du byas te/ de dag gis bden pa mthong nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar ④te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa ⑩bdag cag ⑩legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'byung tsob dang / bsnyen par rdzogs shing dge slong gi dngos po 'thob tu rung na/ bdag cag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du tshangs par (7spyod pa spyad par 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 74wa 280

kyis de dag la ①dge slong tshur shog ces bya ba'i tshig gis rab tu phyung ste bsnyen (mipar rdzogs par mdzad nas/ de dag la lung yang phog ste/ de dag gis kyang brtson pa dang / bsgrub ①pa dang 'bad pas nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas / dgra ④bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas te/ de dag (snyedagra bcom pa khams gsum pa'i 'dod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil du 'dra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/ rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs (6)bcom pa/rig pa dang mngon par shes pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa (7thob pa/srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang / bkur sti (8)la mi lta ba dbang po dang /nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams kyis mchod cing rjed 6)pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis skye bo phal po che 'thab pa las zhi bar mdzad ⑩nas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ da ltar (7'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang ngas nyernyeskye bo phal po che 'di dag bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la ji ltar bkod pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na ri khrod kyi grong zhig na bram ze nyustezhig gis mchod sbyin byas te/ mchod sbyin byed pa der bram ze rnams stan gyi phyir 'thab cipa las de'i tshe dka' mithub kyi gnas shig na/ drang srong 'khor lnga brgya yod pa zhig gnas so/ /de nas mchod sbyin byed pa ⑩der drang srong des bram ze de dag 'thab pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ de lta 74—281

bu dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan te/ des na 6)'thab mo de yang zhi bar gyur la/bram ze rnams kyang skyo ba skyes nas/ de nyid kyi thad du (mirab tu byung ngo / /de dag der rab tu byung nas bsam gtan bzhi chadang mngon par shes pa lnga bskyed do / /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe drang srong du gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe bram zer ④gyur pa gang yin pa de dag ni/ skye bo phal po che 'di dag kho na yin no(5)/ /de'i tshe yang ngas skye bo phal po che 'thab pa zhi bar byas nas bsam gtan bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa (6)lnga la bkod (7do/ /da ltar yang ngas skye bo phal po che 'thab pa zhi bar byas nas/ g.yung drung gi mthar thug pa grub pa dang / bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bkod do/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la 'di dag thams cad rab tu byung rinanonas/ der 'di rnams kyis tshe gcig kyi)tu tshangs par spyod pa spyad nas/dbang po rnams yongs su smin par byas pa des na/ da tu )ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //klu zhes bya ba ni/ gleng gzhi mnyan du yod pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe (sprergyal po gsal rgyal gyi blon po chen po tu zhig gyod cig la btags te/ ci bdog pa phrogs tsho nas/ khri mon du bcug pa las/ de 8der zas dang skom gyis 8mnar te shi'o/ /de nas des smon lam log par btab nas/ shi 'phos te dus las 'das pa'i 'og tu/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa zhig tu skyes nas/ des yul ko sa la de thams cad du mi nad btang steyi/ skye bo phal po che de ⑩dag kha dag 12par gyur nas/ ltas mkhan dag gis smras pa/ blon po chen po des 'chi 74—282

kur tu)smon lam log par btab nas/ gnod sbyin ma rungs par skyes te/des mi nad 'di dag btang (2)ngo zhes byas so/ /de nas de thos ma thag tu skye bo mang po de dudag ci bya gtol med par gyur to/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bsams pa/ 'di ni sus kyang 'dul ( /bar mi nus kyis(5kyi/ da (6)'di'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba gdab dgos so snyam ste/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste ⑦phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi pon zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das la 99)'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis ni 7klu ma rungs pa dga' bo dang / nye dga' bo la sogs pa gzhan dang lhoskregazhan dag kyang btul/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa 'brog 12gnas la sogs pa gzhan dang gzhan dag kyang btul na1lha/ btsun pa blon po chen po (9che ge mo zhig gis smon lam log par btab stemi/ gnod sbyin ma rungs par skyes nas/ des bdag gi yul du mi nad btang na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs brtse ⑩ba'i slad du/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa de gdul 1 bar gsol/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po gsal rgyal la cang mi gsung bas 1 gnang ngo ske/ /de nas rgyal po gsal rgyal bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod de rjes su yi rangs 36nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 3 tshozhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 27thad nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 2)rdzu 'phrul gyis/ gnod sbyin de 3/ rgyal bu 2 rgyal byed kyi tshal gyi 'dab tu ( stebazhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de btul 25ba'i phyir me chen po sprul te/ de'i kho ra 6)khor yug nas bdag nyid me chen pos 'khor bar mthong 74—283

ste / bcom ldan 'das kyi ①zhabs kyi drung 'ba' zhig zhi bar mthong ngo de nas de 'jigs shing skrag nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste ②phyin nas/bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin ma rungs pa de tshul bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzangs rgyakhyod kyis sngon (9mi dge ba'i las byas pas/ rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis ⑥bsad tsa)pa yin na/ da yang khyod 'dir skyes nas skye bo mang po kha 'dogs ⑧par byed na/ 'di nas dzi)shi 'phos pa'i 'og tu khyod kyi ⑩'gro ba ni gang yin/ skye gnas ni gang yin/ 'gro ba'i sa ni gang yin/ gnod sbyin gyis gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' ci stsal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/sdig pa'i las 'di thong ⑩shig /gnod sbyin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 8bdag la bka' ci stsal pa bzhin du 'tshal lo/ /de skad ces gsol te / des 8skyabs su 'gro ba dang / bslab pa'i gzhi rnams blangs nas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bdag gis sdig pa'i las btang lags te④/btsun pa deng slan cad tsomanyan du yod pa na yiganas pa'i skye bo mang po rnams kyi srung tsom dang / skyabs rnams 8ni bdag lags so/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod sbyin ma rungs pa de ⑩btul nas/ skye bo phal po che de pya dag 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su bkod pa la gzigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / da ltar 'ba' zhig ma yin te/ 'das pa'i dus na yang ngas gnod sbyin ma rungs pa 'di btul yinas/ skye bo phal po che ji ltar 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su bkod pa de nyon cigatso /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na grong khyer bā rā ṇa sī na rgyal po tshangs pas byin rgyal po byed dedu/ de'i tshe 74—284

yul ka shir ②klu gdug pa dug ②mi bzad pa zhig byung steni/ des grong yang stongs ④par byedabu/ ljongs kyang stongs ⑥par byed cing / bā rā ṇa sī'i ⑦phyogs su chas ⑧pa las rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyis thos nas/ de thos ma thag tu 'jigs pa chen khyapo skyes te/ des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi go bskon te btang nas/ khyed ⑩deng la klu gdug pa de sod cig (nyaces bsgo'o/ /de nas de dag gis de'i 8rkang pa la phyag 'tshal te/ gsol pa/ lha de ni dpung gi tshogs kyis dgum 8par mi nus kyis8/ sngags sam sman gyis de dgum 8par nus lags so/ /yang na dge ba'i tshul gyis bkur ba'i dge sbyong tsodang / bram ze rnams kyis gdul bar nus lags so zhes gsol to/ /de nas de'i tshe bā rā ṇa sī de nyid na gdol pa'i khye'u byams pa'i rang bzhin can/ snying rje che ba sems can la byams pa zhig gnas pa des/ skye bo mang po de ⑩dag ci bya gtol med par gyur pa mthong nas/ mthong ma thag tu de ()snying rje skyes nas des skye ⑩bo mang po rnams la smras pa/ khyod ( ) ci bya gtol med par bya mi dgos kyis0/bdag gis 0klu gdug pa de gdul bar bya'o zhes byas so/ /de nas de'i pha ma gnyis na re/ de ni dbugs gdug pa yin te khyod kyis de gdul 0mi nus so/ / khye'u des0smras pa/ byams pa'i go cha gyon pa la ( stedes cung ( nyazad kyang gnod par byed mi nus so zhes byas nas/ khye'u des phyogs gang ( stan klu gdug pa ( sme'adug pa'i phyogs der song nas klu gdug ⑥pa des thag ring po zhig nas khye'u de mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang khros nas khye'u de la dbugs btang ngo / /de nas khye'u des 0byams pa la snyoms par zhugs nas byams pa'i lta bas klu gdug du〉pa de la bltas te/ des bltas dum thag tu dug med par gyur to/ /de nas khye'u 74—285

des klu sprul de lag pa gnyis kyis blangs nas mi mi gnas pa'i sa phyogs su ①bzhag (gyigo/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin dang / skye bo mang po gzhan dag gis gdol pa'i khye'u che ge mo zhig gis klu gdug pa btul lo ③zhes thos rtsonas thos ma thag tu rgyal po de rang nyid gdol pa'i khye'u de'i thad du song nas des khye'u de la dam pa sna gcig 'dam du bcug ste/ khye'u khyod la dam pa sna gcig byin ⑤rna zhes byas so/ /khye'us smras pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs te/ gnas par mdzod cig /yul na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la gzud par (6)mdzod cig ces byas ⑦so/ /de nas rgyal po tshangs pas byin gyis khye'u de la ⑧longs spyod kyi byings 7chen po byin nas/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam yang dag par blangs te 'dug go/ /yul na gnas pa'i mi rnams kyang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod do/ /dge slong dag ji snyam du sems / de'i tshe yigadol pa'i khye'ur gyur pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa gang yin pa de ni nga nyid yin no/ /de'i tshe klu gdug par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni/ gnod sbyin ma rungs pa 'di kho na yin no/ /de'i tshe skye bo phal po cher gyur pa /lhagang yin pa de dag (geni/ yul ko kyis la na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po 'di dag kho na yin te/ de'i tshe yang ngas klu gdug pa de ④btul nas/skye bo phal po che 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su bkod do/ /da ⑩ltar yang ngas gnod sbyin ma rungs pa 'di btul nas/ skye bo phal po che 'jigs pa med pa'i gnas su bkod do/ /gzhan yang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung gi gsung rab la 'di dag thams cad dge bsnyen du gyur te/ der 'di rnams kyis tshe gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa 0spyad nas/ dbang po rnams yongs su smin 74—286

par byas pa des na/ da 6)ltar rnam par grol bar gyur to// //shi bi gnyis zhes ②bya ba de la/ shi bi (gyidang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das khyad kyi liyul du ljongs ⑤rgyu zhing gshegs pa las/ chu klung mtha' (7ldan dang /grong khyer ku sha'i ⑦bar gyi lam nas gud 6)du bzur te6)/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla gos bzhi bltab tu bgyis te thing ⑩shig dang / nga'i rgyab mi bde ba (stede tsore zhig bsti ⑫bar bya'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos btsun pa de ltar 'tshal lo zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa bzhin du mnyan tsonas/bla gos bzhi bltab 8tu byas te⑩/ bting nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bla gos bzhi bltab tu ()bgyis te bting lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis da tunyede'i dus la ⑩bab par dgongs su gsol/ de nas ( )bcom ldan 'das kyis 6nyachos gos snam ( )sbyar stug por bltab ste 'phongs 0su bzhag nas/ snang ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa dang ske/ dran pa dang ldan pa dang / shes bzhin dang ldan pa'i 'du shes thugs la dgongs shing glo (stegayas phyogs kyis gzims te( ge/ zhabs gcig gi steng du gcig bzhag ⑩go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'di snyam du dgongs te/'khor 'dir so so'i skye bo'i dge slong ji snyed 'dus shing 'tshogs ⑥pa de dag thams cad ci sangs rgyas kyis 'dul chab yin nam/ 'on te nyan thos kyis 'dul tshub yin zhig gu snyam du dgongs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/ 'di na 4 )kha cig ni sangs rgyas kyis 'dul 4)bar 'gyur ro/ /kha cig ni nyan thos kyis 'dul bar du'agyur 6)snyam du rdusnyedagongs nas/ tshe dang 74—287

ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod byang chub kyi phyogs rnams las spobs par gyis shig /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci nas 'khor thams cad du sgra des gang bar 'gyur ba de lta bur hunyebyin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas dge slong mang po dag gis tshig de lta bu gsungs pa'i ri sgra thos nas/ de dag gis bsams pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi gtam gyis shig par bskul bas na da (5)ni tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos sbrang bu'i gasbrang rtsi btsir (9ba bzhin du 4)chos snyan 47no cog (nyaston par 'gyur snyam ste0/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste ⑩lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das la bskor te 'khod do/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun (nyudaga' bos dge slong rnams la smras pa/ tshe dang ldan pa dag 8dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa hurtel rten 8pa 'dod chags dang bral ba la rten 8pa 'gog pa la rten yipa/ rnam par spong bas nyu yongs su bsgyur ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis 4snyemangon par shes pas/mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas bstan to ༅tshe dang ldan pa dag chos rnam par 'byed pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dben pa la rten yi/pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba la rten ( )pa/ 'gog pa la rten 37pa/ rnam par spong bas shu)yongs su bsgyur ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gemangon par shes pas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas bstan to za(nyezhes / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos byang chub kyi yan lag 'di dag ⑤nyid las brtsams ( —benas dge slong rnams la ( de lta bu dang 'thun 0pa'i chos bstan te/74—288

des 0)na nyan thos dang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'brel pa gang yin pa de dag gis stan de dag ②nyid la 'khod bzhin du/ nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs te②/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum du byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'i gtam gyi mjug ④rdzogs par thugs su chud nas bzhugs (5)te / skyil mo krung ⑥bcas nas sku ⑦drang por bsrangs te(nya/ dran pa mngon du bzhag 6)nas bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal patshu/ kun dga' bo khyod brtson 'grus ston tamayi/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus ston lags soyi/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod snyibartson 'grus ston tam/ gsol pa/ bde bar gshegs pa brtson 'grus ston lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo brtson 'grus ④ni/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro 8zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi phyogs 'di 7dag nyid las yo snabartsams nas/ de lta bu dang 'thun pa'i chos bstan 8te/ des na (6bcom ldan 'das dang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'brel ( )pa gang yin pa de dag gis stan de dag 67nyid la 'khod bzhin du nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs nas/ dgra bcom pa nyid mngon sum ( )du byas te / de dag dudagra bcom pa ( )khams gsum pa'i (nye'adod chags dang bral bar gyur nas/ gser dang bong bar ( nyamanyam pa/ nam mkha' dang lag mthil ( rte'adra ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ tsan dan sbangs pa lta bur bsil bar gyur pa/rig pas sgo nga'i sbubs bubacom pa/ rig pa dang 6)mngon par shes pa dang /so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa/ srid pa'i rnyed pa dang / chags pa dang /bkur ste (sprel mi lta ba/ dbang po dang / nye dbang dang bcas pa'i lha rnams 74—289

kyis mchod cing rjed 0)pa dang / gus par smra ba'i gnas su gyur ②sto/ /①de nas de'i tshe dge slong zhig gis tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ snyan pa'i chos ni gsan pa'i phyir/ /ston pa snyun bzhin ④nyid kyis bskul/ /khyod la byang chub yan lag rnams/ /yod na dge slong khyod ⑤rgod cig /gnas brtan dukun dga' mkhas shing gragasartsi/ / byang bar ⑧gyur pas legs zhes gsol/ /dpa' bo khyod kyi gsung 6)rab la/ /dkar ba'i chos rnams de dag mnga'/ /dran dang rnam 'byed brtson 'grus dang / /dga' dang rab sbyangs ting ⑩'dzin dang ske/ /btang snyoms 'di dag rdul med pa/ /khyod kyi byang chub yan lag lags / /byang chub yan lag bcud thos nas/ /byang chub yan lag bcud kyang rtogs / /bcom ldan snyun 7tshabs che ba las8/ /gnod pa de las zhi bar ⑫gyur / /dam chos rin chen 'di ston 8pa'i/ /chos kyi mnga' bdag de nyid kyang / /dam chos gsan par bzhed gyur na/ /gzhan lta ci ltar de mi nyanatso/ /stobs bcu mnga' bas nye rgyal ni/ /dge slong rnams kyi shes rab mchog /bstan pa gang yin de nyid kyang / /chos mnyan ⑩'dod pas gzir ⑩bar 'gyuratso / /mdo sde 'dul ba ma mo 'dzin/ /mkhas shing tshul dang tshul min shes / /de dag dam chos nyan byed yin/ /gzhan lta 6 )ji ltar de mi nyan/ /mkhas pa shes 'dod sems bzhag nyenas/ /chos bzhin nyan par byed pa ni/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab skyon med la/ /de bzhin dga' ba thob par 'gyur/ /yid dga' lus kyang shin tu sbyangs/ /bde ba yang ni myong bar 'gyur/ /bde bar gyur nas 2nyesems nyid kyis ⑫/ /ting 'dzin la yang reg par 'gyur/ /sems ni mnyam par gzhag (stepa yis/ /'du byed yul ④gyi rnam par tsorig /74—290

srid pa'i 'gro las skyo ①bar 'gyur/ /chags med sems kyis ⑧grol bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu srid 'gro skyo gyur ③na/ /lha dang mi la chags pa med/ /bud shing med pa'i me bzhin du/ /dgra bcom rnams ni mya ngan 'da'akhyi/ /dam chos mnyan ⑤pa'i phan yon ni/ /mang po gzhan yang rgyal bas bstan/ /de phyir 'di ⑥ni yod snyam du/ /ston pa'i bka' ni mnyan par bya/ /de nas dge slong rnams kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ni legs par smras pa ⑦gsung ba dang / legs par smras par (nyebazhed pa lags te⑨ske/ legs par smras pa'i ⑩don gyi slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bskul ⑩ba tsomadzad nas/ bkur sti yidang ldan pas gsan kyang gsan/ bshad kyang bshad pa la yigazigs/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa ni da ⑩ltar 'ba' zhig legs par smras pa gsung ba yidang / legs par smras pa bzhed pa ma yin gyisakyi / de bzhin gshegs pa ni 'das pa'i dus na yang legs par smras pa tsogasung ba dang / legs par smras pa bzhed pa yin te/ legs par smras pa'i don gyi phyir/ ngas mchog tu dka' ba ji ltar spyad ⑩pa de nyon cig /dge slong dag sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ rgyal po'i pho brang bzhi zho )ldan zhes bya ba na/rgyal po ⑥shi bi ⑥zhes bya ba rgyal po byed de/ de'i ring la 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang ⑫/ bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / skye bo dang / mi mang pos gang ba dang / rtsod pa dang / 'thab pa zhi ba dang / 'khrug pa chadang /nang 'khrug dang / chom ( nyerkun dang / nad dang / mu ge med pa dang /'bras sā tsolu dang / bu ram shing dang / ba lang dang / ma te dang ldan par 74—291

'dug ste/ gnod pa med cing tsher ma dkrugs ①la bu gcig ②pa sdug pa la bya ba bzhin du chos bzhin du rgyal srid byed do/ /rgyal po de yang byams pa'i rang bzhin can/ snying rje dang ldan pa/ sems can la byams pa'i ①sbyin pa la sred pa zhig stege/ de sbyin pa dag sbyin (9zhing bsod nams dag byed pa la zhugs ①te/zas 'dod pa la ni zas sbyin par byed/ skom 'dod pa la ni (7skom sbyin par byed / gos 'dod pa la ni gos sbyin par byed/ rgyan 'dod pa la (nyeni rgyan sbyin ⑨par byed/ mal stan 'dod pa la ni mal stan sbyin par byed/ bzhin ⑩pa 'dod pa la ni bzhon pa sbyin par byed/ yo byad gzhan 'dod pa (nyal ni yo byad gzhan 7sbyin par byed do/ /hunyend gso ba'i nad brang bcas te/ yo byad thams cad sbyar nas/ sman pa rnams dang / nad g.yog 7rnams bskos te/nad pa rnams dang / mgon med pa rnams kyi rim gro byed do/ /bza' 8ba dang bca' ba tsomang po dag kyang sta gon yibyas te/ nam mkha' la gnas pa dang / chu la (3gnas pa dang / thang la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams la sbyin par byed do/ /des yi yidam 'di lta bu yang bcas te/ deng phyin cad zhu bdag gis thams cad la thams cad sbyin par bya ste/ 'jig rten dag dge ba 0bcu'i las kyi lam la dgod par bya'o zhes dam bcas nas/ des 'jig rten thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod 'do/ /der dge ba bcu'i las kyi tshulam yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir sems can phal cher shi ba'i 'og tu lha'i nang du skyes nas/ de dag gis lha'i gnas rnams gang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bsams pa/ 'di ci zhig sgrub brgya byin du 'gyur ba sgrub bam( ste/ 'on te tshangs par 'gyur ba sgrub zhig gu byasnyam mo/ /de nas 74—292

pa de'i gzi brjid dang / mthu dpe ma mchis par che ste/ 'byor pa dang /bde ba dang / lo legs pa dang / mi la sogs pa skye bo mang zhing rab tu mang ba dang ldan pa des 'di snyam du bsams te0)/ bdag gis ni rin po che dang /longs spyod kyis 'gro ba thams cad la phan btags kyi/ dam pa'i chos kyi (miphan 'dogs par ma gyur te/ 'di dag ni bdag gi skyon du 'gyur gyis(5)/ dam pa'i chos gang na mchis pa btsal te/ thams cad dgrol bar bya'o snyam du bsams ④nas/ 'di skad ces bkar btags so/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'di na su la dam pa'i chos yod pa de/ bdag la ston par gyur na/ de yid dang mi 'gal bar ci dang ci 'dod pa sbyin no zhes bsgrags kyang ston nus pa ma byung ngo / /de'i tshe na rgyal po de mya ngan gyis yid gdungs te/ mi dga' bar gyur pa ngal bso pos thos nas sad pa'i slad du/ bdag gis (2lus gnod sbyin zhig tu sprul nas / de'i mdog shin tu sngo ba/ gnag (7pa/ mig khrag ltar dmar ba/mche ba gyen du byung ba/ skra gyen du bsgreng ba/ kha nas me 'bar ba/ pho brang gi sgor mchis nas/ su zhig chos thos par 'dod pa nga las nyon cig ces smras so / /rgyal pos de skad ces smras pa thos nas/ shin tu dga' mgu ste/ gnod sbyin de bsu nas mgo bos phyag byas te/ stan mthon po la bzhag nas/ blon po dang / 'khor mang po dag bsdus te/ chos nyan du gzhug (7)pa'i slad du 'khor bar bskor to/ /de'i tshe na gnod sbyin gyis rgyal po la 'di skad ces smras so / /rgyal po chos thos par bya ba ni shin tu dka' bas/ chos nyan par 'dod na / 'di tsam gyis chog pa ma yin no/ /zhes smras pa dang / rgyal pos de la thal mo sbyar te/ khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa de mi 'gal bar thams cad sbyin no 74—401
